blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Byte-level byte-pair encoding (BBPE) tokenizers are attractive for large language models (LLMs) in multilingual settings because they cover all Unicode text. In UTF-8-based BBPE, however, many scripts start from a higher byte-level fallback cost than English: when no learned merges can be applied, a multibyte character requires multiple byte-derived symbols. We call this worst-case pre-merge cost the encoding floor . A higher floor can increase token counts, shrink usable context, and increase per-request cost. Changing the underlying text encoding can reduce this gap, but a single global encoding can also make already-efficient English spans more expensive in mixed-script text. We propose Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), a dual-alphabet tokenizer that keeps characters encoded in 1–2 UTF-8 bytes on the UTF-8 path while routing 3–4-byte UTF-8 characters through UTF-16. This lowers the encoding floor for 3-byte Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) characters in scripts with high token premiums (token counts relative to English) without raising it for already-efficient spans in mixed-script text. UBE changes only the byte representation presented to byte-pair encoding (BPE): the BPE merge rule remains standard, and exact decoding is preserved. UBE also composes with alternative boundary policies and morphology-based representations. In a Unicode 17 audit, UBE exactly round-trips all Unicode scalar values and all inputs in the official normalization, grapheme-break, and emoji test suites. Across intrinsic tokenization evaluations, UBE lowers dispersion in English-normalized token-count ratios, reducing cross-lingual token-budget disparity. In multilingual language model (LM) experiments, UBE matches BBPE’s LM quality. In the main multilingual settings, UBE reduces token counts most for high-premium scripts and also slightly lowers English token counts; these reductions translate into more usable context under fixed token budgets and faster prompt processing in content-matched benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 字节级字节-pair编码(BBPE)的代碼器在多语种环境中对大语言模型(LLM)具有吸引力,因为它们覆盖了Unicode的所有文本. 然而,在基于UTF-8的BBPE中,许多脚本从比英语更高的字节级倒置成本开始:当无法应用学到的合并时,一个多字节字符需要多个字节衍生符号. 我们称这最坏的情况 预置成本编码地板。 较高的楼层可以增加信使计数,缩小可用上下文,并增加按要求计算的费用。 改变基础文本编码可以缩小这一差距,但单一的全球编码也可以使已经高效的英语跨度在混合标语文本中更加昂贵. 我们提出通用字节级编码(UBE),一种双字母代碼器,将字符编码成1–2 UTF-8字节在UTF-8路径上,同时通过UTF-16路由3–4字节UTF-8字符. 这降低了3字节 Basic Multiplane(BMP)字符的编码层,这些字符在脚本中具有很高的符号溢价(与英文相比的托肯计数),而没有在混合标注文本中为已经高效的跨度提高. UBE只更改向字节-pair编码(BPE)呈现的字节表示法:BPE合并规则仍为标准,准确的解码保存下来. UBE还以备选的边界政策和基于形态的表示来组成. 在Unicode 17审计中,UBE精确地将所有Unicode的scalar值以及官方正常化,phramme-break,emoji测试套件中的所有输入进行圆路. 在整个内在的象征性评价中,UBE降低了英文普通代币比率的分布,减少了跨语言代币与预算的差距。 在多语言语言模型(LM)实验中,UBE符合BBPE的LM质量. 在主要多语种环境下,UBE减少高premium脚本的符号计数,也略微减少英文符号计数;这些减值在固定符号预算下转化为更有用的上下文,并在内容匹配的基准中更快的快速处理.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Tokenization is often treated as a preprocessing detail, but in multilingual language modeling it also determines how fixed context and compute budgets are spent across languages. When a tokenizer fragments one language into many more units than another, semantically comparable content consumes more of the usable context window and requires processing longer sequences.
blocks.zh: Tokenization常被视为预处理细节,但在多语种语言模型中,它也决定了固定上下文和计算预算如何在语言之间花费. 当一种示意剂将一种语言片断成比另一种语言多得多的单位时,相模拟的内容消耗更多可用的上下文窗口,需要处理更长的序列.

blocks.en: For autoregressive transformers, prompt token count determines the sequence length processed during prefill, so cross-lingual differences in tokenized length, which we call token-budget disparity under a fixed tokenizer, directly affect usable context, latency, and prompt-processing cost. This disparity is not merely a side effect of multilingual data imbalance; it is also a property of tokenizer design itself ( Petrov et al., 2023 ; Arnett et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 对于自动递归式变压器,即时符号计数决定了在预填时处理的序列长度,因此符号长度的跨语言差异,我们在固定的标注器下称之为符号-预算差异,直接影响到可用的上下文,耐久性,以及即时处理成本. 这种差距不仅仅是多种语文数据不平衡的副作用;它也是标致器设计本身的一个属性(Petrov等人,2023年;Arnett等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: We use fairness in an operational sense: under a shared tokenizer, semantically comparable text should not require systematically different token budgets solely because characters from different scripts have different per-character byte-encoding costs. Even when high-resource languages dominate overall usage, this disparity remains operationally consequential because it reduces usable context under fixed token budgets and affects latency and per-request cost for users writing in scripts with higher byte costs. As multilingual large language models (LLMs) are deployed across APIs, embedded applications, and instruction-tuned assistants, the same disparity also becomes a pricing concern in pay-per-token interfaces ( Ahia et al., 2023 ; Artola Velasco et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们在操作意义上使用公平性:在一个共享的标语符下,模拟可比较的文本不应该仅仅因为不同脚本的字符的每个字符字节编码成本不同而要求系统不同的符号预算. 即使高资源语言在总体使用中占主导地位,这种差异在业务上仍然产生后果,因为它减少了固定符号预算下的可用上下文,并影响到以字节成本较高的脚本写作的用户的耐久性和按要求计算的费用。 由于多语种大语言模型(LLMs)被部署在API,嵌入式应用程序,以及指令调试助理之间,同样的差异也成为按人计酬界面中的价格问题(Ahia等人,2023年;Artola Velasco等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Petrov et al. (2023) show that, under widely deployed tokenizers such as GPT-4’s cl100k_base, parallel Shan text can require up to 15 × 15\times as many tokens as English; by our calculation, a fixed 128K-token context then holds only as much Shan content as about 8.5K English tokens. The problem is especially acute for compact or on-device language models (LMs), where English-centric compact models often use 32K–50K tokenizers ( Allal et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) ; prior work also suggests that tokenizer quality matters more at smaller model scales ( Goldman et al., 2024 ) . Under a compact 16K vocabulary on FLORES-200 ( NLLB Team, 2024 ) , a byte-level byte-pair encoding (BBPE) tokenizer averages 200.188 tokens per parallel sentence for the 12 selected configurations in 3-byte Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) scripts (Appendix Table D.3 ) but only 34.863 for English, so the same context window holds only about one-sixth as much parallel content in these scripts after normalizing by English token counts. Tokenizer design therefore becomes especially consequential for compact multilingual LMs serving mixed-script users under fixed context budgets.
blocks.zh: Petrov等人(2023年)显示,在GPT-4的cl100k_base等广泛部署的标注剂下,平行 掸语文字最多可以要求15×15\时与英语一样多的符号;根据我们的计算,一个固定的128K-token语境所持有的掸语内容只相当于约8.5K英语符号. 这个问题对于紧凑或在线语言模型(LMs)来说特别尖锐,以英语为中心的紧凑模型经常使用32K–50K的标注器(Allal等人,2025年;Liu等人,2024年);以前的工作也表明标注器的质量在较小的模型尺度上更重要(Goldman等人,2024年)。 在FLORES-200(NLLB Team, 2024)上的紧凑16K词汇下,一个字节级的字节-pair编码器(BBPE)的代碼器平均每句200.188令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令令 因此,对于在固定上下文预算下为混合标语用户服务的紧凑的多语种LMS来说,Tokenizer设计尤其具有影响。

blocks.en: BBPE is a useful setting for isolating this issue because it is simple, reversible, and language-agnostic: every Unicode string can be represented using a fixed 256-symbol byte alphabet, and byte-pair encoding (BPE) merges can be learned without language-specific segmentation rules. This simplicity, however, comes with an asymmetry inherited from UTF-8: before any merges are learned, characters from different scripts are represented by byte sequences of different lengths. In BBPE, each character is first decomposed into UTF-8 bytes, and BPE merges then combine frequent adjacent byte-derived symbols into larger tokens. Because a finite multilingual vocabulary cannot cover all subword patterns that arise across languages and text domains, low-coverage spans continue to fall back toward byte-level decomposition. We define the encoding floor for this substrate-imposed fallback as a scalar-level fallback cost: the number of base byte symbols required for one Unicode scalar value under the underlying byte encoding when no learned merge covers it. It is not a lower bound on post-BPE token counts; learned merges can compress frequent characters and multi-character spans below the floor, while underrepresented spans often remain close to it. Under UTF-8, this floor is script- and code-point-dependent (Section 3 , Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: BBPE是孤立这个问题的有用设置,因为它简单,可逆,语言不可知:每个Unicode字符串都可以使用固定的256符号字节字母来表示,而字节-pair编码(BPE)的合并可以不用语言特定的分区规则来学习. 然而,这种简洁性伴随着从UTF-8中继承下来的不对称性:在学习到任何合并之前,来自不同脚本的字符由不同长度的字节序列来代表. 在BBPE中,每个字符首先分解为UTF-8字节,BPE合并后将经常相邻的字节衍生符号合并为更大的符号. 由于有限的多语种词汇不能涵盖语言和文本域中出现的所有子词模式,因此低覆盖跨度继续回落到字节级分解. 我们定义了这个底板施加的回落的编码底板,即一个阶梯级的回落成本:在基础字节编码下一个Unicode scalar值所需的基字节符号数量,当没有学到的合并来覆盖它时. 它不是BPE后符数的下限;学到的合并可以压缩频繁的字符和多字符跨度在下层以下,而代表性不足的跨度往往保持接近它. 在UTF-8下,这一层是脚本和代码点依赖的(第3节,表1)。

blocks.en: The encoding floor is a scalar-level, pre-merge analogue of the corpus-level byte premium ( Arnett et al., 2024 ) , which measures UTF-8 byte-length ratios between content-matched texts. Larger vocabularies absorb more frequent patterns, although added tokens become progressively less frequent ( Reddy et al., 2025 ) , and token-premium disparities persist across comparably trained monolingual tokenizers even as vocabulary size increases ( Arnett et al., 2025 ) ; spans that no learned merge covers still pay the full encoding floor, motivating our aligned token premiums and English-normalized dispersion metrics.
blocks.zh: 编码层是实体级字节溢价(Arnett等人,2024年)的阶梯级和前置模拟物,它测量内容匹配文本之间的UTF-8字节长比. 虽然增加的符号越来越少(Reddy等人,2025年),而且即使词汇体积增加(Arnett等人,2025年),在经过比较训练的单一语言符号符号中,符号-premium的差别仍然存在;没有学会的合并覆盖范围仍然支付全部编码底价,激发了我们一致的符号溢价和英语的正常分布度。

blocks.en: Recent work shows that replacing the byte-encoding substrate can lower this floor for some scripts ( Kim et al., 2026 ) ; however, a uniform replacement can also raise costs for spans already efficient under UTF-8 in mixed-script text. In this work, we propose Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), a dual-alphabet BBPE tokenizer with deterministic per-character routing based on UTF-8 byte length. Characters encoded in 1–2 UTF-8 bytes stay on the UTF-8 path, while 3-byte BMP characters are routed through UTF-16, where they require 2 bytes. Because routing is per character rather than per language, UBE lowers the encoding floor for scripts most exposed to byte-level fragmentation without imposing the uniform 2-byte floor on already-efficient spans in mixed-script text. The method leaves BPE training and merge learning unchanged, preserves exact round-trip decoding for encoded text, and requires no language identification or model-architecture changes.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作显示,替换字节编码底板可以降低一些脚本的这一层(Kim等人,2026年);然而,统一替换也可以提高UTF-8在混写文本中已经高效的跨度的成本. 在这项工作中,我们提出通用字节级编码(UBE),是一种双甲苯BBPE的标注剂,根据UTF-8字节长度确定每个字符的路由. 在1–2 UTF-8字节编码的字符留在UTF-8路径上,而3字节的BMP字符则通过UTF-16进行路由,需要2字节. 因为路由是每个字符而不是每个语言,所以UBE降低最暴露在字节一级破碎的脚本的编码底板,而不将统一的2字节底板强制在混合标注文本中已经高效的跨度上. 该方法使BPE培训和合并学习保持不变,保留了编码文本的精确圆路解码,不需要语言识别或模型-architecture更改.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Petrov et al. (2023) show on parallel text that tokenized length can vary sharply across languages, and Ahia et al. (2023) show that the same content-matched disparity appears in API pricing. We therefore use aligned sentence-level token premiums as our main intrinsic measure of cross-lingual token-budget disparity (Section 4 ). Follow-up work links tokenization disparity to unequal utility, downstream performance, latency, and infrastructure/access costs ( Lundin et al., 2026 ; Dixit and Dixit, 2026 ; Teklehaymanot and Nejdl, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: Petrov等人(2023年)在平行文本上显示,符号化的长度可以因语言而异,Ahia等人(2023年)显示,API定价中也出现了相同的内容匹配差异. 因此,我们使用一致的句子级别象征性溢价作为衡量跨语言象征性预算差异的主要内在尺度(第4节)。 后续工作将象征性的差别与不平等的效用、下游的性能、耐久性和基础设施/接入费用联系起来(Lundin等人,2026年;Dixit和Dixit,2026年;Teklehaymanot和Nejdl,2025年)。

blocks.en: Arnett et al. (2025) analyze causes and mitigations of cross-lingual tokenizer inequity, while Shani et al. (2026) situate tokenizer choices among broader design choices behind multilingual performance gaps. Related metrics quantify disparity at the tokenizer level (Single Token Retention Rate ( Nayeem et al., 2025 ) ), downstream LM-task level (Performance Realization Ratio ( Hu et al., 2025 ) ), and dialectal NLP task level (Tokenization Parity ( Petrov et al., 2023 ) , as applied by Kanjirangat et al. (2025) ). Alqahtani et al. (2026) argue for tokenizer–model co-design and standardized evaluation.
blocks.zh: Arnett等人(2025年)分析了不同语言的标致器不平等的原因和减轻,而Shani等人(2026年)则将标致器选择放在多种语言性能差距背后的更广泛的设计选择中。 相关的衡量尺度在标语一级(Single Token保留率(Nayeem等人,2025年)),下游LM-任务一级(绩效实现率(Hu等人,2025年))和方言NLP任务一级(Kanjirangat等人,2023年)应用的Konjirangat等人(Kenjirangat等人,2025年)对差异进行了量化。 Alqahtani等人(2026年)主张进行标定剂-模型共同设计和标准化评价。

blocks.en: SentencePiece supports BPE and unigram segmentation directly from raw text ( Kudo and Richardson, 2018 ) ; it is not restricted to byte-based representations. Mitigations fall into three groups. Within-substrate methods change merge or segmentation objectives, pre-tokenization, vocabulary allocation, or post-hoc vocabulary additions while keeping the byte encoding fixed ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Schmidt et al., 2025 ; Abagyan et al., 2025 ; Churchill and Skiena, 2026 ) ; these can compose with UBE but leave the UTF-8 encoding floor unchanged. Substrate-changing methods alter the input symbols: BBPE16 applies UTF-16 uniformly ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , SCRIPT-BPE combines a script-aware representation with script/category boundaries and constrained merges ( Land and Arnett, 2025 ) , MYTE learns morphology-driven byte codes ( Limisiewicz et al., 2024 ) , and Bit-level BPE re-splits the byte stream at the bit level ( Moon et al., 2025 ) . UBE instead routes each character between UTF-8 and UTF-16 inside one reversible tokenizer; Section 4.3 and Appendix E compare these representation, boundary, and morphology-based alternatives at the tokenizer and model levels. Tokenization-free and byte-level models operate directly on characters or bytes: CANINE ( Clark et al., 2022 ) , ByT5 ( Xue et al., 2022 ) , BLT ( Pagnoni et al., 2025 ) , MAGNET ( Ahia et al., 2024 ) , and H-Net ( Hwang et al., 2026 ) ; they reduce reliance on fixed tokenizers but change the model’s architecture or input granularity, whereas UBE preserves standard BPE training and exact decoding. The appendix surveys further byte-level architectures (Appendix H.3 ).
blocks.zh: 句子Piece 支持 直接从原始文本(Kudo and Richardson, 2018)中进行BPE和unigram分解;不仅限于字节表达. 缓解分为三类。 基底方法改变合并或分化目标,预tokenization,词汇分配,或hoc后词汇添加,同时保持字节编码固定(刘等人,2025年;施密特等人,2025年;阿巴基扬等人,2025年;丘吉尔和斯基埃纳,2026年);这些方法可以与UBE组成,但留下UTF-8编码底片不变. 基底变化方法改变输入符号: BBPE16统一应用UTF-16(Kim等人,2026年),SCRIPT-BPE将脚本感知代表与脚本/类别边界和受限合并(Land and Arnett,2025年),MYTE学习形态驱动字节代码(Limisiewicz等人,2024年),Bit级BPE在比特级重排字节流(Moon等人,2025年). UBE转而将UTF-8和UTF-16之间的每个字符在1个可逆的代碼器内进行引导;第4.3节和附录E在代碼器和模型级别上比较这些代表,边界,以及基于形态的替代品. 切换无字节和字节级模型直接运行在字符或字节上: CANINE(克拉克等人,2022年),ByT5 (薛等人,2022年),BLT (Pagnoni等人,2025年),MAGNET(Ahia等人,2024年)和H-Net(Hwang等人,2026年),它们减少了对固定标注剂的依赖,但改变了模型的结构或输入颗粒性,而UBE则保留标准的BPE培训和精确的解码. 附录进一步调查了字节级架构(附录H.3).

blocks.en: BBPE ( Wang et al., 2020 ) converts text to UTF-8 bytes and learns BPE merges over the resulting byte stream; in GPT-2-style implementations, following the encoder released with GPT-2 ( Radford et al., 2019 ) , each byte is first mapped to a reversible visible symbol. Under the encoding-floor definition introduced above, BBPE’s floor equals the UTF-8 byte length: 1 for ASCII, 2 for many Cyrillic, Arabic, and Hebrew characters, 3 for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean (CJK) and other 3-byte scripts, and 4 for non-BMP code points (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: BBPE(Wang等人,2020年)将文本转换为UTF-8字节,并在由此产生的字节流上学习BPE合并;在GPT-2风格的实现中,在GPT-2发布的编码器(Radford等人,2019年)之后,每个字节首先被映射为可逆可见符号. 根据上文引入的编码-底版定义,BBPE的地板相当于UTF-8字节长度:1表示ASCII,2表示许多西里尔字母,阿拉伯语和希伯来字母,3表示中文,日文,韩文(CJK)和其他3字节脚本,4表示非BMP代码点(表1).

blocks.en: UBE targets one specific source of multilingual tokenization disparity in BBPE under finite vocabularies: 3-byte BMP scripts that remain close to byte fallback continue to pay a higher per-character cost because their encoding floor (3 bytes) exceeds the 1- and 2-byte cases (Table 1 ). Non-BMP 4-byte code points, including many emoji, are routed through the same deterministic branch but remain 4 base symbols as UTF-16 surrogate pairs; UBE therefore matches BBPE’s 4-symbol encoding floor for these characters, and unless otherwise noted we focus on BMP 3-byte scripts. To preserve compatibility with existing BPE pipelines, we impose three constraints: exact reversibility, unchanged BPE training and vocabulary learning, and no explicit marker tokens for encoding choice, whose signal could later be absorbed by BPE merges.

blocks.en:
BBPE16 ( Kim et al., 2026 ) demonstrated that replacing UTF-8 with UTF-16 lowers the CJK floor to 2 while preserving a language-agnostic byte-level representation, which is well matched to multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) and other settings dominated by CJK text. In the mixed-script LM setting studied here, however, the same global substrate also raises the ASCII floor to 2 (Table 1 ; Figure 1 illustrates the contrast on a mixed-script example). UBE avoids this trade-off with a single deterministic UTF-8/UTF-16 routing rule based on the number of bytes in each character’s UTF-8 encoding: r ⁡ ( c ) = { UTF-8 if ​ | utf8 ⁡ ( c ) | ≤ 2 , UTF-16 otherwise. r(c)=\begin{cases}\text{UTF-8{}}&\text{if }|\mathrm{utf8}(c)|\leq 2,\\
\text{UTF-16{}}&\text{otherwise.}\end{cases} Thus, the routing rule forms a complete partition of Unicode scalar values. The UTF-16 branch serializes code units as UTF-16LE without a byte-order mark. Here, ‘‘character’’ means one Unicode scalar value rather than a user-perceived grapheme cluster; combining-mark sequences and zero-width joiner sequences are routed scalar by scalar, with no additional normalization. Two disjoint 256-symbol alphabets---the GPT-2 byte alphabet for UTF-8 and a Private Use Area (PUA) block (U+E100--E1FF) for UTF-16 1 1 1 Using this PUA range for internal byte symbols does not introduce ambiguity: input characters in the same range are first encoded as UTF-16LE bytes and then mapped to those symbols (Appendix A.3 ). —let the decoder infer the active encoding from each symbol’s alphabet membership, without marker tokens. The full encoder/decoder details, including pseudocode (Algorithms 1 and 2 ) and dual-buffer flush-on-switch decoding, are in Appendix A .

blocks.en: UBE changes the initial symbol stream presented to a standard BPE trainer: the base alphabet becomes the 512-symbol union of both byte alphabets, and the vocabulary is learned from that routed stream. The pair-counting interface and merge-selection criterion remain the standard BPE ones; UBE introduces no script-aware merge rule or marker token. UBE therefore wraps an unchanged BPE core with a routing pre-tokenizer, disjoint base alphabet, and custom dual-buffer tokenizer runtime; the Transformer architecture is unchanged. Proposition 1 in Appendix A.4 proves exact round-trip decoding. Empirically, UBE has no decoding failures on FLORES-200 across 204 languages (100% pass rate) and recovers every tested raw input in an exhaustive Unicode 17 audit spanning all Unicode scalar values and the official normalization, grapheme-break, and emoji test suites. Among the audited tokenizers, only UBE recovers every input: MYTE recovers 1,138,306 of the 1,155,724 inputs, and SCRIPT-BPE applies Unicode Normalization Form C (NFC) and filters Private-Use scalars, unassigned scalars, and Unicode 17 additions (Appendix Table E.7 ).

blocks.en: Keeping ASCII at a 1-byte floor while mapping common BMP 3-byte UTF-8 characters to a 2-byte path requires the decoder to distinguish which byte encoding produced each base symbol. UBE uses a 512-symbol disjoint union alphabet as a simple marker-free construction under unrestricted BPE merges: BPE may form merge tokens whose expanded base symbols span both alphabets (e.g., a Latin–CJK adjacent pair within a single regex chunk); after merge-token expansion, alphabet membership identifies the decoder branch internal to the merge token, so the dual-buffer decoder flushes at the alphabet boundary even when merges span routing boundaries (Appendix D.5.3 reports cross-alphabet merge frequency across vocabulary sizes).
blocks.zh: 在将常见的BMP 3字节UTF-8字符映射到2字节路径的同时,将ASCII保存在1字节地板上,需要解码器来区分哪个字节编码产生每个基符号. UBE在不受限制的BPE合并下使用512同义脱联字母作为简单的无标记构建: BPE可能形成合并符号,其扩展的基础符号跨越两个字母表(如在单个regex块内一个拉丁-CJK相邻的对);在合并-token扩展后,字母成员会识别合并符号内侧的解码分支,因此双缓冲解码器在字母边界上会冲出,即使合并跨越路由边界(Appendix D.5.3报告跨词汇大小的跨字母合并频率).

blocks.en: Our primary intrinsic metric is the language-level token premium computed from sentence-level token counts on aligned text. For a tokenizer τ \tau , language ℓ \ell , and aligned sentence set S ℓ S_{\ell} , let m τ ​ ( ℓ ) = 1 | S ℓ | ​ ∑ s ∈ S ℓ | τ ⁡ ( s ) | m_{\tau}(\ell)=\frac{1}{|S_{\ell}|}\sum_{s\in S_{\ell}}|\tau(s)| denote the mean number of tokens per sentence. We define the premium as π τ ​ ( ℓ ) = m τ ​ ( ℓ ) / m τ ​ ( en ) \pi_{\tau}(\ell)=m_{\tau}(\ell)/m_{\tau}(\text{en}) ; thus π τ ​ ( ℓ ) > 1 \pi_{\tau}(\ell)>1 means that aligned content occupies more positions in the context window than English under the same tokenizer. For dispersion statistics, the English reference row is excluded, so Gini and variance are computed over { π τ ​ ( ℓ ) : ℓ ≠ en } \{\pi_{\tau}(\ell):\ell\neq\text{en}\} (definitions in Appendix E.1 ). For the additional robustness corpora, without using sentence alignment, we compute m τ ​ ( ℓ ) m_{\tau}(\ell) as the mean token count over the available text units (nonempty UDHR line segments, SIB-200 examples, or MGSM questions) and form the same English-normalized non-English ratios before computing Gini; these are descriptive corpus-level comparisons rather than content-matched sentence premiums. Because BBPE tokenizers produce a tokenization for arbitrary Unicode strings rather than emitting unknown tokens ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Radford et al., 2019 ) , we describe such text as byte-fallback-heavy rather than out-of-vocabulary. These tokenizer-level statistics quantify allocation under fixed context and compute budgets: for semantically matched inputs, they determine how much context capacity and prefill computation each language consumes.

blocks.en: In the core BBPE–UBE comparison, both variants use the same BPE pipeline; only the initial symbol stream differs. We compare three fixed mC4 ( Xue et al., 2021 ) raw-text shard configurations: En-only (encoding-stress), 6-lang ({en, zh, ko, ja, hi, th}, narrow-coverage), and 101-lang (full-coverage, used for the main matched LM comparison). The core matrix trains all three configurations at 16K/32K/64K vocabularies, and the 101-lang vocabulary-scaling sweep extends to 128K and 256K; within each configuration–vocabulary pair, the raw input data are held fixed across tokenizer families so token count is a measured outcome. The primary intrinsic benchmark is the FLORES-200 devtest split (1,012 parallel sentences × \times 204 language–script configurations, hereafter languages); pipeline details (shard-local counting, singleton filtering, merge aggregation), corpus construction, and per-configuration token-count statistics are in Appendix Sections B.1 and B.3 .

Across the nine core comparisons, relative reductions range from 6% to 14% (Appendix Table D.1 ).
The relative Gini reduction is largest at En-only/16K and smallest at 6-lang/64K .
Appendix Tables D.1 and D.3 give the full configuration and vocabulary sweeps.
The three-way matrix identifies vocabulary size as the dominant source of variation: broader training coverage narrows the BBPE–UBE gap only after the merge budget is already moderate.
Even at 101-lang/16K , however, UBE still lowers Gini (-12.1%), showing that merge-budget dilution across many scripts keeps many languages near the encoding floor.
A paired language bootstrap over non-English language-level premiums directly supports the dispersion claim: the 95% confidence interval (CI) for Δ \Delta Gini (UBE − - BBPE) is below zero in all nine core comparisons, including [-0.0358, -0.0047] in the primary 101-lang/32K setting (Appendix Table E.1 ).

Under 101-lang/32K , UBE reduces Gini from 0.2183 to 0.1979 (-9.4%) with a mean UBE/BBPE ratio of 0.9920. The largest token-count reductions occur in low-coverage 3-byte scripts such as Santali (Ol Chiki), Central Atlas Tamazight (Tifinagh), and Tibetan, where UBE reduces the byte-level fallback cost from 3 bytes to 2 bytes per character. Across all 204 languages, UBE produces fewer tokens in 189 languages and more tokens in 15 languages.
Figure 2 shows that UBE’s Gini stays below BBPE’s from 16K to 256K, although the gap narrows at larger vocabularies (-1.9% at 256K); Appendix Table D.3 reports the full numerical sweep. The overall upward trend in Gini reflects heterogeneous compression gains among non-English languages (Appendix Sections D.2.1 and D.2.2 ). Because the half-data ablation (Appendix D.4 ) preserves per-language sampling proportions, it tests corpus-size effects rather than language-mixture effects; the near-overlap of full- and half-data curves across all four tokenizer families argues that the scaling pattern is not explained simply by insufficient tokenizer-training volume. Appendix D.5 provides the per-language distribution view, and Appendix D.5.2 provides the script-family view of the same effect.

blocks.en: To test robustness on additional evaluation sets, we repeat the 101-lang/32K comparison on three additional corpora (Table 2 ). The NLTK Unicode UDHR corpus ( udhr2 ; 387 entries, many with no mC4 training data) shows a larger Gini reduction under UBE (-11.1%) than on FLORES-200 (-9.4%), consistent with the encoding-floor mechanism being most visible where many entries remain near the byte-level fallback floor. Because UDHR is widely reproduced and our mC4-overlap audit finds frequent UDHR prefix matches, we treat it as a public-text stress test rather than a clean held-out set (Appendix C.3 ). SIB-200 ( Adelani et al., 2024 ) , a topic-labeled subset of FLORES-200 sentences, also improves (-8.5%), while MGSM ( Shi et al., 2023 ) is effectively unchanged (+0.1%), as expected for its small set of languages, all of which appear in the 101-language mC4 corpus. Appendix Table D.12 reports the full 16K–256K sweep for all four corpora, including the 32K row summarized here. A scan of all mC4 training shards (held-out evaluation shards excluded) finds no exact FLORES-200 matches across 89.47M documents and 101 languages; a 50-character prefix-substring scan finds 53 FLORES-200 overlaps among 201,686 eligible sentences (Appendix C.3 ).

blocks.en:
UBE’s dual alphabet separates the byte identities of the UTF-8 and UTF-16 paths, so it can lose some shared-byte compression relative to BBPE.
Its 512-symbol initial alphabet also consumes 256 merge slots that standard BBPE uses for subword merges.
The En-only regime tests the worst-case cost: with only English training data, UBE wins just 37 of 204 languages at 16K, because most languages cannot recoup the lost merge slots.
Two observations mitigate this.
First, typical regressions are small: at En-only/32K , the median token-count increase for languages where UBE is worse is just 0.016 tokens per sentence (mean 0.238), while UBE’s token-count reductions on scripts that remain near the encoding floor reach up to 155.591 tokens per sentence.
Second, the Gini reduction at En-only/16K (-13.9%) confirms that UBE concentrates its benefits precisely where disparity is largest.
The coverage threshold for the PUA alphabet is low: moving from En-only to just 6 languages spanning Latin text and several 3-byte BMP script families jumps UBE’s per-language wins from 37/204 to 202/204 at 16K.
At 6-lang/32K , UBE wins 191/204 languages.
At 101-lang/32K , it wins 189/204, showing that even modest script coverage enables the PUA alphabet to learn productive merges and offset the alphabet overhead.
Word-level token composition and decomposition examples are collected in Appendix D.5.1 .
Vocabulary diagnostics support the capacity interpretation: at 101-lang/32K , active utilization remains nearly identical to BBPE (99.9% vs. 99.8%), dead merges fall from 13 to 9, and depth-1 merges roughly double (7.9% → \to 17.3%), suggesting that the extra alphabet capacity is not simply stranded (Appendix D.5.3 ).
blocks.zh:
UBE的双字母将UTF-8和UTF-16路径的字节身份区分开来,因此相对于BBPE可以失去一些共享字节压缩.
其512同义词首字母表也消耗了256个合并槽,标准BBPE用于子词合并.
En-Only政权测试最坏情况成本:只有英语培训数据,UBE在16K只赢得204种语言中的37种,因为大多数语言无法对丢失的合并槽进行复合.
有两点可以缓解这种情况。
首先,典型的回归是小的:在En- only/32K中,UBE最差的语言的中位值值增加值仅为每句0.016个令牌(平均值0.238),而UBE在仍然靠近编码层的脚本上的降值则高达每句155.591个令牌.
第二,在En-lext/16K(13.9%)中,基尼的减少证实,UBE将利益集中在差距最大的地方。
PUA字母的覆盖阈值很低:从En-len移动到仅6种语言,跨越拉丁文本,几个3字节的BMP脚本家族跳过UBE的每个语言胜负从37/204到202/204,在16K.
在6-lang/32K,UBE赢得191/204语言.
在101-lang/32K,它赢得了189/204,这表明即使文字覆盖率不高,也能使PUA字母学习生产性的合并,并抵消字母的间接费用.
字级符号组成和分解实例见附录D.5.1。
词汇诊断支持能力解释:在101-lang/32K时,积极使用率与BBPE(99.9%对99.8%)几乎完全相同,死亡合并从13降至9,深度-1的合并大约翻了一番(7.9%===17.3%),这表明额外的字母能力并非只是搁浅(附录D.5.3)。

blocks.en: Table 2: Cross-dataset token-premium Gini ( 101-lang/32K ). UDHR is a public-text stress test with prefix overlaps. The full 16K–256K sweep is in Appendix Table D.12 .
blocks.zh: 表 2: 跨数据集符号附加 吉尼语(101-lang/32K.). UDHR是一种具有前缀重叠的公文压力测试. 完整的16K-256K扫描情况载于附录表D.12。

blocks.en: Gini alone does not capture absolute token cost: BBPE16 achieves the lowest Gini (0.1598), consistent with its CJK-heavy ASR target domain, but its uniform 2-byte floor narrows relative premiums at the cost of higher absolute token counts for English (31.160 → \to 41.317) in mixed-script LM settings. At the 32K main-text point (Figure 2 ; full numerical breakdown in Appendix Table D.3 ), UBE reduces Gini while also slightly lowering the overall average token count (71.889 → \to 69.857). SuperBPE-style boundary relaxation is complementary to UBE but shifts the trade-off: S-BBPE lowers Gini further at 32K (0.1922 vs. 0.1979) while slightly inflating English tokens (31.160 → \to 33.143), and S-UBE lowers Gini further still while plain UBE keeps fewer total FLORES-200 tokens at 16K–64K. Unlike these alternatives, UBE does not increase English cost: in the main multilingual settings ( 6-lang and 101-lang ; En-only excluded), it reduces both 3-byte-script and English token counts and, at 16K–64K, has the lowest total FLORES-200 count among the standalone methods tested. English’s base stream is unchanged; the small difference emerges from other scripts changing global pair counts and merge competition, not its encoding floor. Appendix Tables D.3 and D.4 report the full 16K–256K standalone and composition sweeps.
blocks.zh: 仅吉尼并不能捕捉到绝对的符号成本: BBPE16实现了最低的基尼(0.1598),与其CJK重ASR目标域一致,但其统一的2字节地板缩小了相对的保费,其代价是英语的绝对符号计数较高(31.160~\to 41.317)在混合标本LM设置中. 在32K主文字点(图2;附录表D.3中的数字分类全数),UBE减少吉尼,同时也略微降低总平均符数(71.889~\=69.857). SuperBPE 风格的边界放松与 UBE 互补,但转换权衡: S-BBPE 下限 吉尼在32K(0.1922 vs. 0.1979)进一步,同时略微夸大了英式信使(31.160 →\to 33.143),S-UBE则进一步降低吉尼,而普通UBE则在16K–64K时保持较少的FLORES-200信使. 与这些替代品不同的是,UBE不会增加英语成本:在主要的多语种环境(6-lang和101-lang;En-lected)中,它既减少了3字节标注数,也减少了英语符号计数,在16K–64K时,在测试的独立方法中FLORES-200总计数最低. 英文的基流不变;小的区别来自其他更改全球对数和合并竞争的脚本,而不是其编码层. 附录表D.3和D.4报告16K-256K的完整独立和组成情况。

blocks.en: On 400 naturally occurring mixed-script mC4 documents (Appendix C.2 ), UBE matches or slightly improves on BBPE in 7 of 8 tested languages, with Bengali showing a small regression (+0.4%); BBPE16 applies the same uniform 2-byte floor to both CJK-heavy and already-efficient spans in this slice, so its aggregate token count is 6.6% above BBPE. The same pattern is visible in the core compact setting: under 101-lang/32K , UBE cuts token counts sharply for low-coverage 3-byte scripts such as Santali, Central Atlas Tamazight, and Tibetan, while token counts also decrease slightly for English and Arabic (Table 3 ). On the 100-task multilingual code workload ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Hofman et al., 2026 ) , UBE uses fewer tokens than BBPE in all 11 language versions and both conditions, including the 99.24%-ASCII code condition (Appendix Table E.10 ). A complementary 6-language stress-set slice appears in Appendix C.1 ; full per-language values, including the small regression cases, appear in Appendix I.2 .
blocks.zh: 在400个自然出现的混合标本mC4文档(Appendix C.2)上,UBE与8种测试语言中7种的BBPE匹配或稍有改进,孟加拉语呈现小回归(+0.4%);BBPE16在这个片中对CJK厚度和已经高效的跨度都采用相同的统一2字节底,因此其总符号数比BBPE高6.6%. 在核心紧凑设置中也可以看到同样的模式:在101-lang/32K下,UBE剪切符号对低覆盖的3字节脚本,如Santali,Central Atlas Tamazight,和藏语,而英语和阿拉伯语的符号计算也略有下降(表3)。 关于100任务多语种代码工作量(Jimenez等人,2024年;Hofman等人,2026年),UBE在所有11种语言版本和两个条件中使用的代号都少于BBPE,包括99.24%的ASCII代码条件(附录表E.10. 附录C.1中出现了一个补充的6种语言压力组合切片;附录一.2中出现了完整的每个语言值,包括小回归情况。

blocks.en: 4.2 Language model evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 语文模式评价

blocks.en: To connect intrinsic disparity to downstream behavior, we train matched LM comparisons over {BBPE, UBE} × \times { En-only , 6-lang , 101-lang }; within each setting, the same 101-language mC4 corpus, architecture, optimizer, and token-step budget are held fixed while the tokenizer configuration changes. The primary attribution setting is 101-lang/32K , where BBPE and UBE are exposure-matched to within < 0.3 % <0.3\% raw-text coverage; lower-coverage rows are fixed-compute stress tests where tokenizer quality and raw-text exposure co-vary. The 32K vocabulary was chosen to maximize the BBPE–UBE floor contrast; larger-vocabulary variants, a 1.3B scale check, and appendix-only SuperBPE composition runs are reported in Appendix F.1 , with training details in Appendix B.2 .
blocks.zh: 为了将内在差异与下游行为联系起来,我们在 {BBPE,UBE}\\ tims {仅 en , 6-lang, 101-lang} 上训练匹配的 LM 比较;在每个设置中, 相同的 101 语言 mC4 元件, 架构, 优化器, 和 符号步骤 预算 被固定, 而代号配置 改变 。 主要归属设定为101-lang/32K,其中BBPE和UBE在 < 0.3% < 0.3\% 原始文字覆盖范围内进行接触比对;低覆盖线是固定计算应力测试,其中标定剂质量和原始文字暴露为同质物。 选择32K词汇是为了最大限度地扩大BBPE-UBE的地板对比度;大字段变体、1.3B尺度检查和仅附录的SuperBPE成分运行在附录F.1中报告,培训细节在附录B.2中报告。

blocks.en: We evaluate held-out per-language bits per byte (BPB) on deterministic mC4 terminal shards and zero-shot accuracy on multilingual and English benchmarks. BPB always uses the raw UTF-8 byte count of the underlying text as the denominator for both tokenizer conditions, so BBPE and UBE likelihoods are normalized on the same content scale. Exact model sizes, token budgets, optimizer settings, sequence length, BPB sampling, and evaluation splits are reported in Appendix B.2 . Appendix Table H.1 situates the reported suite against recent tokenizer-comparison papers, and Appendix H.2 surveys compact public LM tokenizer scales.
blocks.zh: 我们评价关于确定性mC4终端软体和关于多语种和英语基准的零射精度的每个字节(BPB)被搁置。 BPB总是将基础文本的原始UTF-8字节计数作为两个代碼器条件的分母,因此BBPE和UBE概率在相同的内容尺度上实现正常化. 准确的模型大小,符号预算,优化器设置,序列长度,BPB采样,评价分拆情况在附录B.2中报告. 附录表H.1将报告的套件与近期的标注剂-比较剂纸放在一起,附录H.2调查压缩了公共LM标注剂的尺度。

blocks.en:
In the primary seed, UBE has lower BPB Gini than BBPE in all three coverage regimes.
Across 3 seeds at 101-lang/32K , however, the mean BPB Gini is effectively tied (BBPE 0.1819 ± \pm 0.0052 vs. UBE 0.1822 ± \pm 0.0074; Appendix Table F.5 ), with cross-seed variability comparable to the gap.
We therefore do not claim a systematic LM-level BPB-dispersion advantage, and we treat the matched end-of-training BPB dispersion as neutral.
Across macro BPB, multilingual benchmarks, and English regression tasks, deltas are small and mixed.
blocks.zh:
在初级种子中,在所有三种覆盖制度中,UBE的BPB Gini比BBPE低.
然而,在101-lang/32K的3个种子中,平均BPB吉尼有效捆绑(BBPE 0.1819 ±\pm 0.0052对UBE 0.1822 ±\pm 0.0074;附录表F.5),交叉种子的变异性与差距相当.
因此,我们并不主张系统化的LM级BPB散射优势,我们把相应的培训结束BPB散射视为中性.
纵观宏观的BPB,多语种基准,以及英语回归任务,三角洲都很小,而且混杂.

blocks.en: Disaggregated by encoding-floor group, held-out BPB differences are small in the median: median Δ \Delta BPB is +0.0064 for 1-byte, +0.0070 for 2-byte, and +0.0029 for 3-byte scripts; in the primary seed, UBE wins 37/101 languages despite near-tied aggregate BPB (+0.0063), a pattern consistent with redistribution rather than uniform improvement. Larger language-specific shifts occur in both directions: Lao improves, whereas Burmese and Sinhala regress. We report BPB Gini as the primary cross-lingual dispersion measure; absolute per-language BPB values (from which any non-ratio dispersion statistic can be recomputed) are in Appendix Table I.6 . At 64K and 128K, intrinsic gaps narrow as merge coverage improves; held-out BPB and downstream benchmark differences stay small and mixed across the 64K, 128K, and 1.3B/32K scale checks, consistent with prior evidence that tokenizer compression or token-count changes need not directly predict downstream LM quality ( Schmidt et al., 2024 ) ; the corresponding LM results are collected in Appendix F.1 , and full per-language XNLI, XCOPA, and BPB tables ( 101-lang/32K ) appear in Appendix I.3 .
blocks.zh: 按编码-底片组分列,被搁置的BPB差异在中位数中小:中位数QQ\Delta BPB为1字节+0.064,2字节+0.0070,3字节脚本+0.0029;在主种子中,UBE尽管接近Tied couple BPB(+0.0063),但赢得了37/101语言,这个模式与再分配一致,而不是统一的改进. 较大的特定语言的班次是双向的: 老挝有所改善,而缅甸和僧伽罗则出现倒退。 我们报告,BPB Gini是主要的跨语种分布衡量标准;附录表一.6列出了每个语种的绝对BPB值(从中可以重算出任何非比例分布统计)。 在64K和128K时,随着合并覆盖面的扩大,内在差距缩小;在64K、128K和1.3B/32K尺度检查中,持有的BPB和下游基准差仍然很小,而且混杂在一起,这与以前的证据一致,即标定剂压缩或令牌计数变化不需要直接预测下游LM质量(Smidt等人,2024年);相应的LM结果在附录F.1中收集,XNLI、XCOPA和BPB表(101-lang/32K)在附录一.3中出现。

blocks.en: Token-count reductions translate into fixed-budget capacity and prefill effects: defining usable-context gain under a fixed token budget as m BBPE ​ ( ℓ ) / m UBE ​ ( ℓ ) − 1 m_{\mathrm{BBPE}}(\ell)/m_{\mathrm{UBE}}(\ell)-1 , Santali (Ol Chiki) gains 53% more usable context at 101-lang/32K , with English also gaining 0.3%; in a separate 6-lang/32K same-content prompt-processing benchmark, end-to-end sequence-processing rate improves by +45.0% for Amharic and +3.9% for English (Appendix Table F.6 ). We report end-to-end rather than isolating self-attention because tokenizer-induced length changes propagate through multilayer perceptron (MLP) and memory-bandwidth costs as well.

blocks.zh: 4.3 组成和说明剂比较

In each comparison, UBE lowers the English, selected-BMP, and overall mean sequence lengths while preserving the complementary component.

blocks.en: SuperBPE-style boundary relaxation ( Liu et al., 2025 ) and SCRIPT-style pre-tokenization ( Land and Arnett, 2025 ) act on a different component from UBE’s byte representation. The SCRIPT-style comparison shares the official script/category split but retains BBPE/UBE symbols and standard, unconstrained BPE merges. Compared with standard pre-tokenization, SCRIPT-style achieves a lower overall mean primarily through reductions on South Asian scripts (Appendix Table E.2 ). Replacing BBPE with UBE also lowers Gini under all three boundary policies (Appendix E.2 ). The same pattern holds with a 50 MiB/language training cap (Appendix Tables E.3 and E.5 ).
blocks.zh: SuperBPE风格的边界放松(Liu等人,2025年)和SCRIPT风格的预托化(Land and Arnett,2025年)与UBE的字节表示不同。 SCRIPT风格的比较共享官方脚本/类别拆分,但保留BBPE/UBE符号和标准,不受限制的BPE合并. 与标准预调相比,SCRIPT风格主要通过减少南亚脚本实现较低的总体平均(附录表E.2.). 将BBPE换成UBE,也使得Gini在所有三个边界政策下都较低(附录E.2.). 同样的模式是50米B/语言培训上限(附录表E.3和E.5)。

blocks.en: Keeping MYTE’s released decomposition and morphology-merge maps fixed ( Limisiewicz et al., 2024 ) , we route only residual characters through UBE. MYTE-UBE preserves MYTE’s decoded output while reducing total base-symbol positions by 4.58% (201/204 language–script configurations lower, three tied; Appendix Table E.6 ). These are pre-BPE base symbols, not learned BPE tokens.
blocks.zh: 保持MYTE释放的分解和形态-融合图的固定(Limisiewicz等人,2024年),我们只通过UBE来引导剩余字符. MYTE-UBE保留了MYTE的解码输出,同时将总的基数符号位置减少4.58%(201/204语言–语句配置降低,3个绑定;附录表E.6). 这些是BPE前的基础符号,而不是学习过的BPE符号.

blocks.en: In the separate five-tokenizer comparison in Appendix Table E.3 (50 MiB/language), official SCRIPT-BPE attains the lowest overall mean and token-premium Gini. UBE uses fewer English tokens and fewer tokens in 169/204 language–script configurations (Appendix Table E.4 ). SCRIPT-BPE’s gains concentrate in specific script cohorts; this pattern persists across vocabulary sizes, larger training prefixes, and XNLI/XCOPA/MGSM inputs (Appendix E ).

The five 182M models share the training stream and seed; their step counts match the supervised UTF-8 byte exposure of the separately trained UBE model. Differences among the five tokenizers are small (Table 6 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: UBE replaces BBPE’s single UTF-8 substrate with exactly reversible per-character UTF-8/UTF-16 routing while keeping standard BPE intact; the routing itself requires neither language identification nor a Unicode script table. It reduces token-budget disparity across the main intrinsic evaluations, especially at 16K–64K, and composes with SuperBPE-style and SCRIPT-style boundary policies and MYTE’s morphology maps while preserving each complementary mechanism. Downstream differences remain small and mixed; in the source-byte-matched BBPE/BBPE16 comparison UBE has the lowest BPB and BPB Gini, while same-content prompt processing improves by up to +45.0%. UBE is most useful for compact vocabularies and low-coverage 3-byte BMP scripts near the encoding floor.
blocks.zh: UBE将BBPE的单一UTF-8底盘替换为完全可逆的每个特性的UTF-8/UTF-16路由,同时保持标准BPE完好无损;路由本身既不需要语言识别,也不需要Unicode脚本表. 它缩小了主要内在评价之间的象征性预算差异,特别是在16K–64K时,并用SuperBPE型和SCRIPT型边界政策和MYTE的形态图组成,同时保留每个互补机制。 下游差异仍然很小,且混合;在源字比对的BBPE/BBPE16比较中,UBE的BPB和BPB吉尼的BPB比例最低,而同含量的即时处理则提高高达+45.0%. UBE对于紧凑的词汇和低覆盖的3字节BMP脚本靠近编码层最有用.

blocks.en: UBE addresses only the substrate-level source of token-budget disparity; per-language vocabulary sizing, data balance, pre-tokenization, and merge-rule interventions remain orthogonal. Its 256 extra PUA symbols reduce wins at very narrow coverage ( En-only/16K : 37/204) and forgo BBPE’s coincidental byte sharing across scripts, causing small regressions in a few high-coverage languages. LM evaluation covers 182M/32K, 230M/64K, 329M/128K, and 1.3B/32K settings, with 3 seeds only at 101-lang/32K . The largest intrinsic token-count gains occur for some low-coverage 3-byte scripts outside the 101-language mC4 LM corpus, so downstream gains for those exact languages remain untested. Because UBE changes the tokenizer vocabulary, it is not a drop-in replacement for existing checkpoints. A model-level comparison includes SCRIPT-BPE and derived 32K MYTE+BPE; the released 256-symbol MYTE itself and Bit-level BPE remain future work. Constrained-decoding throughput is also left for future work (Appendix H.4 , including broader impacts).
blocks.zh: UBE只解决象征-预算差异的底部一级来源;每个语言词汇的大小,数据平衡,预切,以及合并规则干预仍然为正统. 其256个附加的PUA符号在非常狭窄的覆盖度(En- only/16K:37/204)和放弃BBPE的偶然字节在脚本间共享,导致少数高覆盖语言的小回归. LM评价涵盖182M/32K,230M/64K,329M/128K和1.3B/32K设置,只有101-lang/32K的3个种子. 在101语言mC4LM程序表之外,一些低覆盖的3字节脚本获得最大的内在符号计算收益,因此这些准确语言的下游收益仍未经过测试。 因为UBE更改了标语词汇, 一个模型级的比较包括SCRIPT-BPE,并衍生出32K MYTE+BPE;发布的256符号MYTE本身和Bit级BPE仍然是未来的工作. 约束-解码的吞吐量也留给今后的工作(附录H.4,包括更广泛的影响)。

blocks.en: A.1 Pre-tokenizer: UTF-8-byte-length routing

blocks.en: The pre-tokenizer applies three stages sequentially:

blocks.en: UBE uses the same GPT-2 byte-level pre-tokenizer pattern as the BBPE baseline in this paper to split input text into word-like chunks: 's|'t|'re|'ve|'m|'ll|'d| ?\p{L}+| ?\p{N}+ | ?[^\s\p{L}\p{N}]+|\s+(?!\S)|\s+ In the core BBPE/UBE tokenizer artifacts, the Stage-1 pre-tokenizer is configured with use_regex=true and add_prefix_space=false ; no prefix space is inserted before regex splitting during tokenization. The tokenizer-level normalizer is null , so inputs are used as received, with no Unicode normalization, lowercasing, accent stripping, or compatibility folding. All tokenizer families reserve five added special tokens with IDs 0–4: <s> , <pad> , </s> , <unk> , and <mask> ; each is serialized with special=true and normalized=false . This stage is held fixed across tokenizer families, so UBE changes the byte substrate rather than the word-boundary policy or special-token convention.
blocks.zh: UBE使用与本文中BBPE基线相同的GPT-2字节级前切除器模式将输入文本分割成类似字块 : 's|' t|'re|' ve|' m|'ll|'d|?\p{L}+|?\p{?}\p{{?}{{{}}}}}}}{{{?}}}}} 在核心的BBPE/UBE装饰器文物中,Stage-1预切除器被配置为使用_regex= truth,并添加_prefix_space=false;在标志化时没有在regex分割前插入前缀空间. 标致器级的规范化器是无效的,因此输入按接收时使用,没有Unicode规范化,下加码,重音脱除,或兼容折叠. 所有象征性家庭都保留5个附加的特别代号,编号为0-4: "s " 、 " pad " 、 " /s " 、 " unk " 和 " mask " ;每个代号的序号为 " 特殊=真 " 和 " 规范=假 " 。 这个阶段被固定在象征性的家庭之间,因此UBE会改变字节底部,而不是字段界限政策或特殊托肯公约.

blocks.en: Each character is routed by a deterministic rule based only on its UTF-8 byte length. Here, “character” refers to one Unicode scalar value (the Rust char unit used by the implementation), not a grapheme cluster; isolated surrogate code points are outside this well-formed input domain: • UTF-8 path : characters whose UTF-8 encoding is 1–2 bytes (e.g., ASCII and many Latin Extended, Cyrillic, Greek, Arabic, and Hebrew code points). • UTF-16 path : characters whose UTF-8 encoding is 3–4 bytes. This route includes all 3-byte BMP scalar values and 4-byte non-BMP scalar values; only the former receive a byte-floor reduction, from 3 UTF-8 bytes to 2 UTF-16 bytes. Examples of 3-byte BMP scripts and code points include CJK characters, Devanagari, Bengali, Tamil, Thai, Georgian, Tibetan, Ethiopic, Myanmar, and Khmer.

blocks.en: We complement Figure 1 (which gives the 9/10/7 base-symbol totals for “GPU 性能” under BBPE, BBPE16, and UBE) with the byte-level mapping for the CJK character 性(U+6027): BBPE encodes it as 3 UTF-8 bytes ( 0xE6, 0x80, 0xA7 ), mapped to the GPT-2 alphabet, while UBE encodes it as 2 UTF-16LE bytes ( 0x27, 0x60 ), mapped to PUA (U+E127, U+E160).

blocks.en: The PUA block U+E100–E1FF is used only as an internal visible-byte alphabet for the UTF-16 path; raw input scalar values from the same Unicode range are still encoded as ordinary input characters before alphabet mapping. For example, a raw U+E100 character is a 3-byte UTF-8 scalar and is routed to the UTF-16 path. Its UTF-16LE bytes are 0x00, 0xE1 , which are represented by the two internal symbols U+E100 and U+E1E1. During decoding, these symbols are interpreted as byte values, reconstructed as the UTF-16 code unit 0xE100, and emitted as the original raw scalar value. Thus there is no separate collision case: alphabet membership identifies the byte buffer, while the reconstructed code unit determines the final Unicode scalar.
blocks.zh: PUA块 U+E100–E1FF 仅用作UTF-16路径的内部可见字节字母;来自同一Unicode范围的原始输入scalar值在字母映射前仍作为普通输入字符编码. 例如,一个原始的U+E100字符是3字节的UTF-8 scalar,并被路由到UTF-16路径. 其UTF-16LE字节为0x00,0xE1,由两个内部符号U+E100和U+E1E1代表. 在解码时,这些符号被解释为字节值,重建为UTF-16编码单位0xE100,并释放为原始的原始scalar值. 因此没有单独的碰撞案例:字母成员识别字节缓冲,而重建的代码单位则确定最终的Unicode scalar.

blocks.en: Let s s be a well-formed Unicode scalar-value string with no isolated surrogate code points, and let s + s^{+} denote the string after the tokenizer’s optional prefix-space preprocessing. If BPE merge tokens are expanded to base symbols before buffer routing, then decode ​ ( encode ​ ( s ) ) = s + \text{decode}(\text{encode}(s))=s^{+} . In particular, decode ​ ( encode ​ ( s ) ) = s \text{decode}(\text{encode}(s))=s whenever prefix-space preprocessing does not modify s s .

blocks.en:
Prefix-space preprocessing, when enabled and applicable, deterministically replaces s s with s + s^{+} before regex splitting; the remaining argument is therefore about reconstructing s + s^{+} . BPE decoding first expands each merge token into a sequence over the two base alphabets. The encoder maps each input scalar value of s + s^{+} into exactly one of two disjoint symbol alphabets: the visible-byte alphabet used by the UTF-8 path, and the private-use alphabet used by the UTF-16 path. Because the alphabets are disjoint, every emitted symbol uniquely identifies which byte buffer must receive it during decoding. When the symbol stream switches paths, the previously active buffer is flushed and decoded before any byte from the new path is appended, so the decoder never forms a mixed UTF-8/UTF-16 byte string. Within a same-path run, the decoder does not need to know character boundaries: the encoder wrote a concatenation of complete UTF-8 byte sequences or complete UTF-16 code-unit sequences, and the standard UTF-8 and UTF-16 decodings are bijective on well-formed byte or code-unit sequences (including surrogate-paired non-BMP scalar values), so the original scalar values are recovered. Special tokens trigger a flush of both buffers and are passed through unchanged, preserving token boundaries. Therefore every encoded span is reconstructed exactly, and the final concatenation is s + s^{+} ; if prefix-space preprocessing is disabled or leaves s s unchanged, this is the original string s s . We additionally verified this round-trip property empirically on FLORES-200 (204 languages, 206,448 sentences, 100% pass rate).
∎

blocks.en: This proposition is a round-trip guarantee for token sequences produced by the encoder, not a claim that every arbitrary model-generated token sequence expands to a well-formed UTF-8 or UTF-16 byte string. The UBE decoder follows the usual robust byte-tokenizer convention: malformed same-path byte runs are decoded with replacement characters rather than raising an exception, so generation remains total while exactness is guaranteed only on encoder-produced streams.
blocks.zh: 这个命题是对编码器生成的符号序列的圆形保证,而不是声称每个任意的模型生成的符号序列扩展为一个造型良好的UTF-8或UTF-16字节字符串. UBE解码器遵循通常的强健字节-tokenizer常规:畸形的同路径字节运行用替换字符解码,而不是提出例外,因此生成仍然完整,而精确性只保证在编码器生产的流上.

blocks.en: The Rust core implements the routing pre-tokenizer, dual-buffer decoder, and offset post-processor, with Python wrappers exposing standard Hugging Face training APIs; the incremental training pipeline (Appendix B.1 ) is a separate systems layer. UBE implements the Hugging Face PostProcessor interface for downstream span-extraction compatibility; our configurations set trim_offsets=false so that leading/trailing whitespace offsets are returned as-is.
blocks.zh: Rust核心执行路由前置调试器,双缓冲解码器,并抵消后处理器,Python包装器曝光标准的Hugging Face训练API;增量训练管道(Appendix B.1)是一个单独的系统层. UBE 执行 Hugging Face PostProcessor 接口, 用于下游跨度- 提取兼容性; 我们的配置设置 trim_ offets= false , 以便引导/ 拖动的白空间偏移返回 。

blocks.en: The decoder state needed for streaming consists only of the active alphabet tag and one pending byte buffer. The local invariant after any emitted base symbol is: all flushed output is valid Unicode, and the only unflushed bytes belong to exactly one path, either UTF-8 or UTF-16. When the next expanded symbol has the same alphabet, its byte is appended to the pending buffer; when its alphabet differs, the pending buffer is decoded and emitted before the new buffer is started. Special tokens also force both buffers to flush. Therefore cross-alphabet BPE merges do not create mixed byte strings after token expansion, and streaming implementations can expose committed output at flush points while retaining at most the current same-alphabet byte run as pending state. Guided or grammar-constrained decoders need access to the same per-symbol alphabet tag before applying byte-level constraints; otherwise a constraint engine cannot tell whether a byte value is being interpreted as UTF-8 or UTF-16. We audit this as an implementation requirement rather than a throughput result; constrained-decoding latency is not benchmarked in this paper.
blocks.zh: 流转所需的解码器状态仅包括活动字母标记和一个待决字节缓冲器. 任何被排放的基符号之后的本地变量是:所有被冲掉的输出都是有效的Unicode,唯一的未流出的字节都属于完全一个路径,要么是UTF-8,要么是UTF-16. 当下一个扩展的符号具有相同的字母表时,其字节被附加在待决缓冲器上;当其字母表不同时,待决缓冲器在新缓冲器开始前被解码并释放出来. 特殊标志也迫使两种缓冲. 因此,跨阿尔法贝特BPE合并不会在符号扩展后产生混合字节字符串,流线执行可以暴露在冲点的已承诺输出,同时最多保留当前与待定状态相同的阿尔法贝特字节运行. 被引导或语法约束的解码器在应用字节级限制前需要访问相同的每个音节字母标记;否则约束引擎无法分辨一个字节值是UTF-8还是UTF-16. 我们将此作为执行要求而不是通过量结果来审计;本文件没有将限制解码延迟作为基准。

blocks.zh: 附录B 培训和评价程序

blocks.en: B.1 Tokenizer training pipeline
blocks.zh: B.1 切除器培训管道

blocks.en: All tokenizers (BBPE, BBPE16, UBE) are trained using a two-phase distributed BPE pipeline. The canonical entry point is train_tokenizer.py , which dispatches phase-1 shard processing and phase-2 merge/finalization. Phase 1 computes shard-local states once, and phase 2 merges and finalizes those states into the target vocabulary. This design separates shard-level word-count collection from merge selection, enabling reuse of shard states across vocabulary sizes for a fixed tokenizer type and fixed shard manifest.
blocks.zh: 所有标定剂(BBPE,BBPE16,UBE)都使用两相分布的BPE管道进行训练. Cononical入口为train_tokenizer.py ,它发送阶段-1的硬加工和阶段-2的合并/最终化. 第一阶段计算一次硬-局部状态,第二阶段将这些状态合并并敲定为目标词汇. 这种设计将硬度的单词计数集合与合并选择区分开来,使得硬度状态在词汇大小上可以重复用于固定的标致器类型和固定的硬度表.

blocks.en: Each training shard (an Arrow file containing raw text) is processed independently. For each shard, we: 1. Extract the text column from the Arrow file. 2. Initialize a fresh BpeTrainer with vocab_size set to the maximum target for the sweep being produced (64,000 for the core 16K/32K/64K sweep, with larger targets used for extended diagnostics) and min_frequency=2 . 3. Run train_from_iterator_incremental(finalize=False) , which accumulates pre-tokenized word counts without performing BPE merge selection. Pair statistics are derived from the retained word table during finalization. 4. Save the resulting word-count state to a JSON file via trainer.save_state(path) . The save-state threshold min_frequency=2 filters per-shard singletons (word patterns appearing only once in a single shard), reducing state file size. This is a noise-reduction step, not a final vocabulary decision. Shard states are independent and can be computed in parallel across workers.
blocks.zh: 每个训练硬度(一个包含原始文本的箭头文件)都是独立处理的. 对于每个硬度, 我们: 1. 从箭头文件提取文本列 。 2. 初始化新BpeTrainer,其 vocab_大小设定为正在生产的扫荡的最大目标(核心16K/32K/64K扫荡为64,000个,扩展诊断为更大目标)和min_频率=2. 3.运行列车_从_iterator_increemental(Finalize=False),该列车在不进行BPE合并选择的情况下,积累了预切字数. 平价统计来源于定稿时保留的单词表。 4. 通过trainer.save_state(path)将由此产生的单词计算状态保存为JSON文件. 保存状态阈值 min_频度=2 过滤器 per-shard singletons(单shard中只出现一次字型),缩小状态文件大小. 这是一个减少噪音的步骤,而不是最后的词汇决定. 沙德州是独立的,可以在工人中间平行计算。

blocks.en: Initialize a fresh BpeTrainer with vocab_size set to the maximum target for the sweep being produced (64,000 for the core 16K/32K/64K sweep, with larger targets used for extended diagnostics) and min_frequency=2 .
blocks.zh: 初始化一个新鲜的BpeTrainer,其vocab_大小设定为正在生产的扫荡的最大目标(核心16K/32K/64K扫荡的64,000个,使用更大的目标进行扩展诊断)和min_频率=2.

blocks.en: Run train_from_iterator_incremental(finalize=False) , which accumulates pre-tokenized word counts without performing BPE merge selection. Pair statistics are derived from the retained word table during finalization.
blocks.zh: 运行列车_ from_iterator_increemental(finalize=False),该列车在不进行BPE合并选择的情况下,会累积预to化的单词计数. 平价统计来源于定稿时保留的单词表。

blocks.en: Save the resulting word-count state to a JSON file via trainer.save_state(path) .
blocks.zh: 通过 trainer.save_ state( path) 保存生成的单词计数状态为 JSON 文件 。

blocks.en: All shard states are merged by summing retained word counts in a single parallel reduce pass with no merge-time pruning or post-reduction filtering in the canonical path. Because addition is commutative and associative, the retained word-count totals are order-independent and exact over the retained shard states. This is not equivalent to exact whole-corpus BPE, however, because phase 1 already removes per-shard singletons: patterns appearing once in multiple shards can be lost before the reduce ever sees them. For the 101-language configuration this canonical merge retains approximately 139M unique word patterns after phase-1 filtering, and all retained patterns are carried into the subsequent BPE merge step.
blocks.zh: 所有shard状态都通过在单平行的减速中进行集合保留单词计数而合并,在卡通路径中不进行合并时间的普勒或后减速过滤. 由于加法是共通的和关联的,所保留的字数总数是单数独立和精确的,高于所保留的硬态. 然而,这不等于精确的全军BPE,因为第1阶段已经清除了每个硬的单体:一次出现在多个硬体中的图案可能会在减压者看到它们之前丢失. 对于101语言的配置,这种犬科合并在第一阶段过滤后保留了大约139M独有的单词图案,所有保留图案都被带入后续的BPE合并步骤.

blocks.en: The merged state is finalized by running the full BPE merge loop up to the target vocabulary size: • finalize(vocab_size=target, min_frequency=2) : the final BPE merge loop runs with the same numerical threshold used when saving shard states. • Setting min_frequency=2 at finalization preserves the behavior of the reported tokenizers. The resulting tokenizer is saved as a Hugging Face-compatible tokenizer.json .

blocks.zh: 在定稿时设置 min_频率=2 保留了所报告标语符的行为.

blocks.en: The merge routine records token-frequency metadata derived from the merged filtered state, including a token_counts.json sidecar alongside the tokenizer artifact; the vocabulary-utilization diagnostics in Appendix D.5.3 use these counts to compute dead-merge and active-utilization statistics.

blocks.en: The core sweep used for the paper’s 9 significance-tested conditions trains tokenizers at three vocabulary sizes: 16K, 32K, and 64K, with 101-lang extensions at 128K and 256K. All rows include the same S = 5 S=5 special tokens, so the available merge slots are V − S − 256 V-S-256{} for BBPE and V − S − 512 V-S-512{} for UBE; Table B.1 reports the resulting accounting.

blocks.en: Our preparation scripts construct Arrow shards under data_dir/{lang}/*.arrow , reserve one terminal shard per language for held-out evaluation as 99999.arrow , and hold the raw-data manifest fixed across tokenizer families. The frozen 101-language mC4 [ Xue et al., 2021 ] mirror therefore contains 2,273 train shards and 101 held-out evaluation shards overall. As discussed in the main text, 101-lang/32K is the cleanest downstream attribution setting because BBPE and UBE see nearly identical raw-text coverage there; the lower-coverage settings are retained as fixed-compute stress tests.
blocks.zh: 我们的准备脚本在data_dir/{lang}/*.arrow下构建Arrow shards,将每个语言的1个终端硬度保留为99999. arrow,并将原始数据表固定在标致家。 冰冻101语言的mC4[薛等人,2021年]镜体因此包含2,273辆列车的硬盘和101个被搁置的评价整体硬盘. 如正文所述,101-lang/32K是最干净的下游归属设置,因为BBPE和UBE在那里看到几乎相同的原始文字覆盖;低覆盖设置作为固定计算应力测试保留.

blocks.en: The BPE merge loop is deterministic given the merged word-count table, but hash-map iteration order can change how equal-frequency ties near frequency boundaries are resolved. A retrain without deterministic tie handling is therefore frequency-exact (all merged pair counts are identical across runs) but not necessarily bit-for-bit reproducible : a small number of merges near frequency boundaries may be reordered.
blocks.zh: 鉴于合并的字数表,BPE合并循环是决定性的,但散列图迭代顺序可以改变频率边界附近的等频连接是如何解决的. 因此,没有确定带处理的重排是频率精确的(所有合并的对数在跨运行时是相同的),但不一定比特为位重排:少数接近频率边界的合并可能被重排.

blocks.en: The tokenizer directories used in this work are fixed and define the canonical artifacts for all reported experiments. For deterministic reruns of tie-prone training stages, our training scripts expose --deterministic-tie-breaks , which passes deterministic_tie_breaks=True to the custom BPE trainer and applies stable secondary keys to equal-frequency alphabet and post-merge-pruning ties.
blocks.zh: 本作品中使用的标注器目录是固定的,并定义了所有报告实验的犬科文物. 为了确定易结的训练阶段,我们的训练脚本暴露了-定型-断型,它通过定型_tie_breaks=True到定制的BPE训练器,并将稳定的二键应用到同等频率的字母和发生后连接.

blocks.en: As a sensitivity check, we retrained the 6-lang/32K UBE tokenizer with this deterministic-tie mode. The retrained tokenizer keeps the same 32K vocabulary size and five special-token IDs and round-trips multilingual samples without <unk> emission. Table B.2 compares the original tokenizer to this deterministic-tie variant on the same intrinsic datasets. The differences are at most 0.0005 in Gini and 0.0028 in mean premium, so the paper’s intrinsic conclusions are not driven by hash-map tie order in this stress setting. We treat this as a targeted sensitivity check rather than as a full deterministic retrain sweep across all vocabulary sizes.
blocks.zh: 作为灵敏度检查,我们重新训练了6-lang/32K UBE的标致器,使用这个定型-tie模式. 重新训练的标语器保留了相同的32K词汇大小和5个特殊的托肯ID和圆路多语种样本,没有"unk"的排放. 表B.2在同一个内在数据集上将原始的标注剂与这个定型-tie变体进行比较. 吉尼的差值最多为0.0005,平均溢价为0.0028,因此报纸的内在结论并非由这种压力环境下的散列图领带顺序所驱动。 我们将此视为一种有针对性的敏感性检查,而不是一种跨越所有词汇大小的全面的确定性再培训。

blocks.zh: 表B.2:UBE 6-lang/32K的定型断结敏感度检查。 \\ Delta 列报告 Det. 减去最初的 UBE 表示器 。

blocks.zh: B.2 语文模式培训和评价配置

blocks.en: The primary two-scale LM matrix spans the 182M/32K coverage matrix and the Chinchilla-style [ Hoffmann et al., 2022 ] 1.3B/32K scale check. The reported core LM suite contains 16 runs: this primary matrix plus a separate 329M/128K composition check for S-BBPE and S-UBE. We additionally report 12 appendix LM runs: 6 230M/64K vocabulary variants, 2 182M/32K SuperBPE composition rows, and 4 extra random-seed repeats for the matched 101-lang/32K setting. All runs keep the LM corpus fixed to the 101-language mC4 release; runs differ in tokenizer coverage, vocabulary size, model scale, or seed. Within each setting, architecture, optimizer, and token-step budget are matched while the tokenizer configuration changes; raw-text exposure can therefore differ in the lower-coverage fixed-compute stress rows. The LM dataloader applies no language-level temperature sampling or resampling: it deterministically shuffles a fixed, capped set of per-language shards, so the retained shard volumes determine the language mixture. Table B.3 summarizes the reported core suite, and Table B.4 reports the 32K token-budget estimates per configuration.

LM数据加载器没有应用语言级别温度取样或再取样:它定型地洗涤了一组固定的,封顶的每语言的硬体,因此保留下来的硬体卷决定了语言混合物. 表B.3概述了报告的核心套件,表B.4报告了每个组合的3,2K令牌预算估计数。

The 182M, 230M, and 329M runs use 14L/12H/768d (head dimension 64, MLP 3072); the 230M and 329M variants differ from the 182M/32K setting only by the 64K and 128K vocabularies, respectively. The 1.3B runs use 24L/16H/2048d (head dimension 128, MLP 5504). Positional encoding is RoPE only, applied to all query/key head dimensions ( rotary_percentage=1.0 , rope_base=10000 , rope_condense_ratio=1 ), with no learned absolute position embeddings. The feed-forward sublayer is a LLaMA gated SiLU MLP, SiLU ⁡ ( x ​ W 1 ) ⊙ x ​ W 2 \mathrm{SiLU}(xW_{1})\odot xW_{2} , followed by an output projection. blocks.en: The tokenizer-dependent differences in Table B.4 arise from the per-configuration tokenizer rather than from the raw corpus. Table B.5 summarizes the raw mC4 corpus size used for each tokenizer-training configuration. blocks.en: D.2.1 Why Gini rises with vocabulary size
blocks.zh: D.2.1 吉尼为何随着词汇的大小而上升

blocks.en: Figure D.1 visualizes the mechanism behind the Gini increase observed in Table D.3 . Script families compress at vastly different rates. Across the 16K–256K vocabulary sweep, English token counts fall by 24.2%, whereas Hindi (Devanagari) token counts fall by only 5.6%. Because premiums are ratios to English, Hindi’s premium rises from 2.57 to 3.20 (+0.63) even though its absolute count decreases slightly. Meanwhile, languages that can still form long merges (Arabic: 40.7% reduction, premium -0.43; Korean: 37.6%, -0.23) converge toward English. The net effect is a widening premium distribution—75 of 204 languages see their premium increase—that drives Gini upward. This pattern is expected for BPE on a multilingual corpus when merge productivity is script-dependent: some script families absorb more productive merges per added vocabulary slot than others. UBE lowers the intercept of the premium curve but does not remove this vocabulary-scaling effect.
blocks.zh: 图D.1可视化表D.3所示基尼增长背后的机制。 脚本家庭的压缩率差别很大. 而印地语(Devanagari)则只减少5.6%。 由于保费与英语的比率,印地语保费从2.57上升到3.20(+0.63),尽管其绝对数略有下降。 同时,仍然能够形成长融合的语言(阿拉伯语:العدي الدي ,40.7% ,溢价−0.43;韩语:37.6%,−0.23)向英语汇合. 净影响是溢价的扩大——204种语言中的75种增加了溢价——促使吉尼向上。 当合并生产率依赖脚本时,BPE在多语种体上预计会出现这种模式:一些脚本家庭在增加的词汇槽中吸收的合并效果比其他家庭要高. UBE降低了溢价曲线的截取量,但并没有消除这种词汇缩放效果.

blocks.en: Complementing the standalone BBPE/UBE and BBPE16 results in Table D.3 , Table D.4 reports the full S-BBPE/S-UBE composition sweep. The table adds two details to the main-text summary: among the SuperBPE composition rows, S-UBE has lower Gini than S-BBPE at every vocabulary size, while plain UBE keeps fewer total FLORES-200 tokens than S-UBE at 16K–64K; and the bounded, sign-changing interaction term supports a qualitative complementarity claim rather than exact additivity.

blocks.en: We implement S-BBPE and S-UBE as SuperBPE-style extension runs, not as separately designed tokenizers. Each reported target vocabulary size V ∈ { 16 ​ K , 32 ​ K , 64 ​ K , 128 ​ K , 256 ​ K } V\in\{16\text{K},32\text{K},64\text{K},128\text{K},256\text{K}\} starts from an already trained Stage 1 tokenizer of the same substrate at vocabulary size V / 2 V/2 (BBPE for S-BBPE, UBE for S-UBE), loads its merges.txt as ordered seed merges, and then continues BPE training until the total vocabulary reaches V V . The Stage 1 seed tokenizers are intermediate artifacts only; all reported S-BBPE/S-UBE result rows use the 16K–256K target vocabularies. This mirrors the two-stage structure of SuperBPE: Stage 1 learns an ordinary whitespace-splitting BPE tokenizer over the chosen substrate, and Stage 2 reuses those merges while relaxing the pre-tokenizer so that cross-word merge candidates can be selected.
blocks.zh: 我们执行S-BBPE和S-UBE作为SuperBPE风格的扩展运行,而不是作为单独设计的标致器. 每一个报告的目标词汇大小V { { 16 K, 32 K, 64 K, 128 K, 256 K} V\ in\ 16\ text{K}, 32\ text{K}, 64\ text{K}, 128\ text{K}, 256\text{K} 起始于词汇大小V / 2 V/2 (S-BBPE 的 BBPE, S-UBE 的 UBE) , 从一个已经受过训练的阶段 1 的标注符开始,加载其合并. txt作为命令种子合并,然后继续BPE训练,直到总词汇达到V V. 第1阶段的种子标注器只是中间文物;所有报告的S-BBPE/S-UBE结果行都使用16K-256K目标词汇. 这映射了SuperBPE的两阶段结构:第1阶段在所选底物上学习一个普通的白空分割BPE的标注器,第2阶段在放松前切换器的同时再利用这些合并,从而可以选择跨字合并候选人.

blocks.en: The Stage 2 implementation is shared by the two composed variants. Our train_superbpe.py script first regenerates shard-local count states using a permissive regex pre-tokenizer rather than the normal GPT-2 whitespace-splitting regex; these states cannot be reused from BBPE/UBE training because they contain multi-word chunks that ordinary pre-tokenization never exposes. Shard-local pre-tokenized chunks occurring fewer than five times are discarded before aggregation; new merges use a minimum frequency of two. It then merges the shard states, initializes the BPE trainer with the substrate-specific base alphabet and the Stage 1 seed merges, replays the seed merges in their original order, rebuilds the pair-count priority queue from the permissive-regex corpus state, and resumes the standard greedy BPE merge loop. The only substrate-specific branch is the byte representation used before BPE: S-BBPE uses the standard UTF-8 byte-level alphabet, pre-tokenizer, and decoder; S-UBE uses UBE’s UniversalByteLevel alphabet, pre-tokenizer, and decoder, so routed UTF-16 PUA symbols participate in the same SuperBPE Stage 2 merge loop. In both cases we retain SuperBPE’s colon-space block and four-word cap (at most four whitespace-separated words per merged token), which avoids unbounded multiword tokens; the reported tokenizer sidecars record the base type, seed-merge count, selected shard-state count, target vocabulary, and these SuperBPE constraints.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段的实施由两个构成的变体分担。 我们的列车_superbpe.py脚本首先使用允许的regex预tokenizer来重现shard-local计数状态,而不是普通的GPT-2 白空间分割 regex;这些状态不能从BPPE/UBE训练中重复使用,因为它们包含普通预tokenization从未暴露的多字块. 在合并之前,不到5次的硬化本地预切块被丢弃;新的合并使用最小频率为2次。 然后它将硬态合并,初始化BPE教练器与底板特有的基字母和阶段1种子合并,按照原始顺序重播种子合并,从允许-regexecut状态重建对数优先排队,恢复标准贪婪的BPE合并循环. 唯一的底板特异性分支是BPE之前使用的字节表示: S-BBPE使用标准的UTF-8字节级字母表,预tokenizer,以及解码器; S-UBE使用UBE的UniversalBytelevel字母表,预tokeneless,以及解码器,因此路由式的UTF-16 PUA符号参与同一个SuperBPE阶段2的合并循环. 在这两种情况下,我们保留了SuperBPE的结肠-空格块和四字封顶(每个合并的符号最多四个白空分隔的字),这避免了未绑定的多字封顶符号;据报道的标致器侧车记录了基型,种子聚集计数,选定的硬态计数,目标词汇,以及这些SuperBPE限制.

blocks.en: The interaction term of the 2 × 2 2\times 2 factorial, defined on signed relative-Gini changes as combined% − - UBE% − - SuperBPE% (negative individual terms correspond to Gini reductions), is bounded but sign-changing across vocabulary sizes: +4.4% at 16K, +0.3% at 32K, -1.7% at 64K, -3.8% at 128K, and -4.4% at 256K (mean -1.1%). A positive value indicates that the composition falls short of the summed individual reductions (interference); a negative value indicates that the composition exceeds the sum (mild synergy). This pattern supports a qualitative complementarity interpretation, not a uniform near-additive law: small-vocabulary alphabet overhead and larger-vocabulary cross-word merge opportunities affect the sign of the interaction. At 64K, a bootstrap over 203 languages (10K resamples) places the interaction at -1.7% with a 95% CI of [-3.2%, -0.1%], indicating that this negative interaction point is small but distinguishable from zero. We do not claim a uniform interaction sign across vocabulary sizes.

blocks.en: Tables D.6 and D.7 illustrate the mechanism at the word level. For short Ol Chiki and Tifinagh words, BBPE produces exactly 3 tokens per character because it has learned virtually no merges for these scripts even at 64K vocabulary: each character’s 3 UTF-8 bytes remain as separate base symbols. UBE starts at 2 base symbols per character via the UTF-16 path, and BPE training has additionally learned cross-character byte merges, pushing the token count below the 2-per-character baseline. For a 24-character Ol Chiki sentence fragment, the combined floor and merge advantage yields 63 BBPE tokens versus 39 UBE tokens (38% reduction). UBE通过UTF-16路径以每个字符2个碱基符号开始,BPE训练还额外学习了跨字符字节合并,将符号计数推向了每个字符2个字节基线以下. 对于一个24字符的Ol Chiki句子片段,合并的地板和合并优势产生63个BBPE令牌,相对于39个UBE令牌(减少38%). 表D.8在16K-256K全部词汇扫描中扩展了相同的字数和句数级实例,表D.9在FLORES-200上报告了相应的按标注的家庭平均值。

blocks.en: Table D.10 reports vocabulary utilization metrics for the four 101-lang/32K tokenizers. A dead merge is a learned merge token with count exactly zero when the finalized tokenizer retokenizes the frequency-weighted, merged filtered training word table used to produce its training-time token_counts metadata. UBE’s 512-symbol alphabet does not appear to strand merge capacity: active utilization is 99.8%, all 256 PUA symbols are used, and UBE has fewer dead merge tokens (9) than BBPE (13). Roughly 23.6% of UBE’s merges join two pure PUA tokens (UTF-16-path merges), indicating that the UTF-16 path learns productive subword patterns. The higher dead-merge counts for S-BBPE and S-UBE (524/531 vs. 13/9) reflect SuperBPE’s permissive cross-word merges, which create long-tail tokens that are not emitted in this final training-time retokenization. Mixed-alphabet results account for 9.8% of merges, including merges with an already mixed operand; the remainder stay entirely within one alphabet. UBE also produces 2 × 2\times more depth-1 merges (17.3% vs. 7.9%) because routed BMP characters can be completed after a single merge from 2 UTF-16 bytes, whereas BBPE typically needs 2 successive merges to collapse a 3-byte UTF-8 decomposition before character-spanning subword merges become available. Depth-1 share is not a standalone quality metric; here, the higher share reflects that the alphabet has already paid much of the floor cost, so fewer hierarchical merges are needed to reach character-level units. Together with 99.8% active utilization and use of all PUA symbols, this indicates that the extra alphabet capacity is productively spent rather than stranded.
blocks.zh: 表D.10报告4个101-lang/32K标注器的词汇利用率指标。 死化合并(英語:Dead conference)是指在最终定型的标语器重新对频率加权,合并的滤波训练词表用于生成其训练时的符号_计数元数据时,完全为零的已学习的合并符号. UBE的512同义字母表似乎没有线程合并容量:活动利用率为99.8%,全部使用256个PUA符号,而UBE的死合并符(9)比BBPE(13)少. 大约23.6%的UBE合并加入两个纯PUA符号(UTF-16-path合并),表明UTF-16路径学习生产子词模式. S-BBPE和S-UBE(524/531 vs. 13/9)的死因较高,反映了SuperBPE允许的跨字合并,这创造了长尾符号,在最后的训练时间重生中不会释放出来. 混合-甲胺结果占合并的9.8%,包括已混合的合并;其余完全停留在一个字母之内。 UBE还产生2×2\times more deep-1合并(17.3% vs. 7.9%),因为路由BMP字符可以在从2个UTF-16字节进行单一合并后完成,而BBPE通常需要连续2个合并才能在字符拓扑子词合并可用前崩溃3字节UTF-8分解. 深度-1份额不是一个独立的质量衡量标准;在这里,较高份额反映出字母已经支付了大部分的底价,因此需要较少的层次合并才能到达字符级单位. 加上所有PUA符号的99.8%的活跃利用率和使用率,这表明额外的字母容量是生产性的而不是搁浅的.

blocks.en: MYTE is a morphology-driven 256-symbol byte representation learned from language-specific resources and used directly as model input [ Limisiewicz et al., 2024 ] . We apply its released decomposition and morphology-merge maps unchanged, retain the generated code bytes, and route only residual characters through UBE. The compact 512-symbol MYTE-UBE representation shares one 256-symbol region between residual UTF-8 bytes and MYTE code bytes, which are both copied verbatim into the post-MYTE byte stream, and keeps a separate 256-symbol region for routed UTF-16 bytes. No learned BPE is applied to Table E.6 ; one emitted base symbol is one model-input position. MYTE-UBE reduces the selected-BMP mean by 28.10% and total positions by 4.58% relative to MYTE, is lower in 201/204 configurations, ties in three, and is higher in none. On all 206,448 FLORES-200 sentences, MYTE-UBE reconstructs the post-MYTE byte stream exactly and matches MYTE’s released decoder output.

Contract 512-symbol MYTE-UBE 表示法在残留的UTF-8字节和MYTE代码字节之间共享一个256-symbol区域,两者均被逐字复制到MYTE后字节流中,并为路由的UTF-16字节保留单独的256-symbol区域. 表E.6没有应用学到的BPE;一个发射的基准符号是一个模型输入位置。 MYTE-UBE将所选的BMP平均比MYTE减少28.10%,总位置比MYTE减少4.58%,在20204配置中更低,连结为3个,在0个配置中更低. 在全部206,448 FLORES-200句子上,MYTE-UBE完全重建后MYTE字节流,并与MYTE发布的解码器输出匹配.

blocks.en: F.3 Context-window and prompt-processing benchmark
blocks.zh: F.3 背景窗口和快速处理基准

blocks.en: Table F.6 reports same-content prompt-processing measurements for BBPE and UBE. We include this benchmark as a deployment-side check of the main context-window claim: shorter prompts for the same semantic content move byte-fallback-heavy scripts farther from the truncation boundary. We describe the full methodology below, informed by the benchmarking principles of Hoefler and Belli [2015] and Georges et al. [2007] .
blocks.zh: 表F.6报告了BBPE和UBE的同含量快速处理测量。 我们把这一基准作为主要上下文窗口要求的部署边检查:对距离截断边界更远的同一种语义内容移动字节倒背重脚本的较短提示。 根据Hoefler和Belli[2015年]和Georges等人[2007年]的基准原则,我们描述以下全面方法。

blocks.en: Table F.6: Same-content prompt-processing benchmark on 5-sentence FLORES-200 bundles ( 6-lang/32K , 182M, A100 80 GB, batch 1, FP32, torch.compile ). Token columns are bundle lengths; rates use 30 trials with 95% CI half-widths over 28 samples after symmetric min/max trimming. Δ \Delta tok = (UBE − - BBPE)/BBPE and Δ \Delta spd = relative sequence-rate change.
blocks.zh: 表F.6:5-判决FLORES-200捆捆绑(6-lang/32K,182M,A100 80GB,第1批,FP32,火炬.compile )的相同内容快速处理基准。 托肯柱为捆绑长度;速率使用30个试验,在对称的分钟/最大修剪后,CI半宽超过28个样本的95%. \Delta tok = (UBE - - BBPE)/BPE和\Delta spd = 相对序列率变化。

blocks.en: All measurements are conducted on a single NVIDIA A100 80 GB GPU with exclusive access, using PyTorch torch.compile (Inductor backend, dynamic=True ), batch size 1, FP32 precision, and single-stream scheduling consistent with the MLPerf Inference single-stream scenario [ Reddi et al., 2020 ] . The 6-lang/32K tokenizer configuration is used to separate well-covered scripts (en, zh, ko, ja, hi, th) from byte-fallback-heavy scripts (my, am, ar, ru).
blocks.zh: 所有测量均在单NVIDIA A100 80 GB GPU上进行,独家访问,使用PyTorch火炬. 编译(Inductioner后端,动态=True),批量尺寸1,FP32精度,以及符合MLPerf推论单流情景的单流调度[Reddi等人,2020年]. 6-lang/32K的标致器配置用于将覆盖完好的脚本(en,zh,ko,ja,hi,th)与字节倒背重的脚本(my, am, ar, ru)分开.

blocks.en: Each language is measured independently with CUDA event timing. Following Hoefler and Belli [2015] , we report the timing mechanism and explicitly control for timer overhead, synchronization, warmup, and measurement variability. We execute 5 warmup iterations (to stabilize torch.compile code generation, cuDNN autotuning, and GPU thermal state), followed by 30 independent trials of 20 forward passes each for each tokenizer condition. We apply symmetric min/max outlier removal (1 from each tail, ∼ \sim 3.3% trim) to guard against cold-cache and scheduling artifacts. Following Georges et al. [2007] , we report t t -distribution confidence intervals, appropriate for the 28 effective samples remaining after trimming ( n < 30 n<30 ). The primary summary is the trimmed mean ± \pm 95% CI; untrimmed statistics are also reported for robustness verification.
blocks.zh: 每种语言都用CUDA事件时间独立测量. 在Hoefler和Belli[2015]之后,我们报告计时机制,并明确控制计时器的俯冲,同步,热量,和测量的可变性. 我们执行5次热电(稳定火炬). 编译代码生成,cuDNN自动调制,以及GPU热态,之后进行30次独立试验,每个标定器条件每个前传20次. 我们采用对称的分/最大离子清除法(每个尾部1个,\sim 3.3%,crim)来防范冷藏和安排文物。 继Georges等人[2007年]之后,我们报告 t t - 分布置信间隔,适合在三剪切后剩余的28个有效样品(n < 30 n < 30)。 主要摘要是经修剪的平均值±\pm 95% CI;还报告了未经修剪的统计数据,以进行可靠性核实。

blocks.en: We report only prompt processing. Transformer prefill contains a self-attention term that scales as O ⁡ ( n 2 ​ d ) O(n^{2}d) in sequence length [ Vaswani et al., 2017 ] ; I/O-optimized implementations reduce memory traffic but do not remove this sequence-length dependence [ Dao et al., 2022 ] . Prompt processing is therefore the most direct deployment-side measurement we report for tokenizer-induced context-window pressure and truncation risk. Autoregressive decode, by contrast, is often memory-bandwidth-bound [ Shazeer, 2019 , Pope et al., 2023 ] , with per-step attention cost scaling linearly in key–value (KV) cache length, so input-length reductions still help but through a different cost path.
blocks.zh: 我们只报告迅速处理。 变形器预填包含一个自留名词,该词在序列长度上缩放为O ⁡(n 2 d) O(n^{2}d),[Vaswani等人,2017年];I/O-优化执行减少内存流量,但不消除这种序列长度依赖[Dao等人,2022年]. 因此,快速处理是我们报告最直接的部署侧度量,以衡量标致剂引起的上下文窗压力和截断风险。 相比之下,自动回转解码往往是内存-带宽绑定[Shazeer, 2019, Pope et al., 2023]],每步关注成本在键 - 值(KV)缓存长度中线性缩放,所以输入长度的减速仍然有帮助,但通过不同的成本路径.

blocks.en: Let r = n UBE / n BBPE r=n_{\text{UBE}}/n_{\text{BBPE}} denote the UBE/BBPE token-count ratio on the same prompt (derivable from the Δ \Delta tok column in Table F.6 ). The floating-point operation (FLOP)-only scaling terms 1 / r − 1 1/r-1 for MLP-dominated prefill ( O ⁡ ( n ​ d 2 ) O(nd^{2}) ) and 1 / r 2 − 1 1/r^{2}-1 for attention-dominated prefill ( O ⁡ ( n 2 ​ d ) O(n^{2}d) ) provide reference points, but launch overheads, embedding/output layers, and memory effects shift the observed rate. At the width tested here ( d = 768 d=768 , 182M scale) and the prompt lengths in Table F.6 , the MLP term n ​ d 2 nd^{2} is comparable to or larger than the attention term n 2 ​ d n^{2}d for most languages, so observed rates fall closer to linear-in- n n than to quadratic. This matches the data: Amharic (-32.1%, +45.0%) shows the largest speedup; Hindi and Thai, whose token counts barely change, show small but statistically significant speed changes (+0.1%, +0.5%); and English and Arabic deviate from FLOP-only estimates, which we attribute to fixed and kernel-level effects.
blocks.zh: 让 r = n UBE / n BBPE r=n_{\text{UBE}}/n_{\text{BBPE}}}表示UBE/BBPE在同一快件上的令牌计数比率(可从表F.6中的\\Delta tok栏中找到). 浮点操作(FLOP)只缩放术语 1 / r – 1 1/r-1,用于 MLP 主导的预填(O ⁡ (n d 2) O(nd^{2})) 和 1 / r 2 – 1 1/r^{2}-1,用于注意力主导的预填(O ⁡ (n 2 d) O(n^{2}d) ) 提供了参考点,但发射机顶,嵌入/输出层,内存效应转移了观察到的速率. 在此处测试的宽度(d = 768 d = 768,182M比例尺)和表F.6中的快速长度,MLP术语n d 2 nd^{2}与大多数语言的注意词n 2 d n^{2}d相当或更大,因此观测到的速率更接近线性-n n n 而不是四进制. 这与数据相符:阿姆哈拉语(-32.1%,+45.0%)显示速度最大;印地语和泰语(其信使数几乎没有变化)显示速度变化很小,但统计学意义显著(+0.1%,+0.5%);英语和阿拉伯语则偏离了仅FLOP的估计数,我们将其归结为固定和内核级效应.

blocks.en: We report sequences/second (seq/s) rather than tokens/second. Because different tokenizers produce different token counts for the same text—with disparities up to 15 × 15\times across languages [ Petrov et al., 2023 ] —tokens/second conflates token count with processing rate. Normalizing by the original text content, following prior content-matched multilingual cost comparisons [ Ahia et al., 2023 ] , yields a metric that directly compares how quickly each system ingests the same natural-language input under the same model and hardware budget.
blocks.zh: 我们报告序列/秒(seq/s)而不是符号/秒。 因为不同的标语对同一文本产生不同的标语计数——不同语言之间差异高达15×15乘[Petrov等人,2023年]——托肯斯/秒将标语计数与处理速率. 按照先前内容匹配的多语种成本比较[Ahia et al., 2023],按原始文本内容实现正常化,得出一个衡量标准,直接比较每个系统在同一个模型和硬件预算下摄入相同自然语言输入的速度。

blocks.en: For each language, we compute Welch’s t t -test (unpaired, unequal variance) and Mann–Whitney U U as a distribution-free check. Welch’s test is appropriate because BBPE and UBE are benchmarked as separate timing samples and produce different sequence lengths for the same text. To control for multiple comparisons across 10 languages, we apply Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) correction at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 . The compact table reports rates and confidence intervals; after FDR correction, 8/10 language pairs are significant, while Chinese (Simplified) and Burmese are not, matching their near-zero measured speed changes. Error bars capture run-to-run variability under otherwise fixed hardware and software conditions; residual variance arises primarily from GPU scheduling, thermal drift, and measurement noise.
blocks.zh: 对每种语言,我们计算Welch的 t t - t测试(unpaired, 不平等差异)和Mann - Whitney U U作为无分布检查. Welch的测试是恰当的,因为BBPE和UBE作为单独的计时样本作为基准,为同一文本产生不同的序列长度. 为了控制10种语言的多重比较,我们应用Benjamini-Hochberg假发现率(FDR)的校正值为α=0.05\alpha=0.05. 紧凑表报告速率和置信间隔;FDR校正后,8/10语言对数相当显著,而汉语(简写)和缅甸语则不同,与其测量的近零速度变化相匹配. 错误栏记录在本来固定的硬件和软件条件下运行到运行的变异;剩余差异主要来自GPU排程,热漂移和测量噪音.
