blocks.en: Public papers, technical reports, and model cards rarely disclose the exact number of languages used for tokenizer training. Table H.3 therefore reports the public language scope stated in official papers, technical reports, model cards, blogs, or configs rather than the tokenizer-training language count, and should be read as a deployment-facing survey rather than a like-for-like tokenizer-training comparison. When a row spans a model family, the Scale column reports the public training-token range across the listed parameter sizes. The pattern is nevertheless informative. Many English-centric compact models still operate with 32K–50K vocabularies, while compact public multilingual models either remain 32K-class (Phi-3.5-mini) or jump to much larger family tokenizers (Llama 3.2, Qwen 2.5). This is the regime split most relevant to UBE: small or moderate vocabularies leave less room to absorb script-specific merge coverage, whereas very large multilingual vocabularies partially compensate through scale alone. Table H.3 compiles representative public examples; sources are listed below the table to identify the source for each row’s language scope, vocabulary scale, and training scale.

blocks.en: H.3 Extended related work
blocks.zh: H.3 延长的有关工作

blocks.en: A growing cluster of work addresses tokenization for specific script families. Rana et al. [2026] propose MUTANT, a recipe for multilingual tokenizer design with language-aware pre-tokenization and subword/multiword-aware training; their MUTANT-Indic tokenizer improves average fertility by 39.5% over Llama 4 across English, 22 Indian languages, and code. Brahma et al. [2025] propose Constrained BPE (CBPE), which enforces script-specific constraints for Indic scripts—keeping dependent vowels cohesive with base consonants. Velayuthan and Sarveswaran [2025] replace byte-level character extraction with grapheme-aware units, benefiting abugida scripts whose written units (graphemes) span multiple code points. Thakur et al. [2025] systematically study vocabulary size, pre-tokenization rules, and training-corpus composition for Indic scripts, linking these choices to both token-to-word efficiency and model quality. More recently, Darshana [2026] proposes a three-layer syllable-aware architecture that separates script-specific segmentation from BPE compression and reports large token reductions for Sinhala and Hindi. These papers show that script-specific solutions are increasingly common, but each targets a particular script family. UBE instead applies one reversible, language-agnostic routing rule based on UTF-8 byte length, without requiring per-language or per-script rules.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的工作涉及特定剧本家庭的象征性化。 拉纳等人. [2026] 提出MUTANT,是多语种标语设计的一种配方,具有语言意识预触和子词/多语种意识训练;他们的MUTANT-Indic标语比Llama 4在英语,22印度语,代码上的平均生育力提高了39.5%. Brahma et al. [2025] 提出 Constract BPE(CBPE),它执行对Indic脚本的脚本特定限制——保持与基调一致的依赖元音. Velayuthan和Sarveswaran [2025] 将字节字符提取替换为石墨感知单位,受益者是书面单位(graphemes)跨越多个代码点的bugida脚本. 塔库尔等人. [2025]系统地研究词汇大小,前置规则,以及Indic脚本的训练-公司构成,将这些选择与符号对字的效率和模型质量都联系起来. 最近,Darshana [2026] 提出一个三层音节感知架构,将脚本专用的分解与BPE压缩分开,并报告僧伽罗语和印地语的大量象征性减少. 这些文件表明,针对脚本的解决方案越来越常见,但每个解决方案都针对一个特定的脚本家族. 相反,UBE应用了一个基于UTF-8字节长度的可逆,语言不可知的路由规则,而不需要按语言或按标规则.

blocks.en: An alternative strategy is to reduce reliance on a fixed tokenizer altogether. CANINE [ Clark et al., 2022 ] operates directly on Unicode characters, and ByT5 [ Xue et al., 2022 ] operates on UTF-8 bytes. MAGNET [ Ahia et al., 2024 ] learns adaptive segmentation boundaries within the model. SpaceByte [ Slagle, 2024 ] and BLT [ Pagnoni et al., 2025 ] show that raw-byte language modeling can become competitive when the architecture allocates computation unevenly across a byte stream. More recently, Bolmo [ Minixhofer et al., 2026 ] introduces a family of open byte-level LMs using a two-stage “byteification” procedure that converts subword models into byte-level models with minimal additional training. FLEXITOKENS [ Owodunni et al., 2026 ] uses learnable boundary predictors between bytes, reducing over-fragmentation and improving performance on token-classification and generative tasks. H-Net [ Hwang et al., 2026 ] learns content- and context-dependent byte segmentation jointly with the model, outperforming BPE-tokenized Transformers with especially large gains for Chinese and code. MrT5 [ Kallini et al., 2025 ] adds a learned delete gate to ByT5 that dynamically shortens byte sequences, adapting compression rates per language. These approaches show that segmentation can be moved into the model, but they change the model’s architecture or input granularity and are generally not direct replacements in existing subword-tokenizer training and inference pipelines.
blocks.zh: 另一种战略是完全减少对固定装饰剂的依赖。 CANINE [Clark et al., 2022]在Unicode字符上直接运行,ByT5 [Xue et al., 2022]在UTF-8字节上运行. MAGNET[Ahia等人,2024年]在模型内学习适应分化边界. SpaceByte [Slagle, 2024]和BLT [Pagnoni等人, 2025] 显示,当架构在字节流中分配计算不均匀时,原始字节语言模型可以变得具有竞争力. 最近,Bolmo [Minixhofer等人,2026年]采用两阶段的“字节化”程序,将子词模型转换成字节级模型,并进行最低限度的额外培训。 FLEXITOKENS [Owodunni等人,2026年]在字节之间使用可学习的边界预测器,减少过多的裂解,提高在符号分类和基因分配任务上的性能. H-Net [ Hwang et al., 2026)]与模型共同学习内容和上下文依赖的字节分解,比BPE-tokenized变形器表现优异,对汉语和代码特别大的收益. MRT5[Kallini等人,2025年]在ByT5中增加了一个学习的删除门,能动态缩短字节序列,适应每种语言的压缩率. 这些方法表明分解可以移入模型,但是它们改变了模型的结构或输入颗粒性,并且一般不是在现有子词切除器培训和推论管道中的直接替换.

blocks.en: H.4 Additional scope and limitations
blocks.zh: H.4 额外范围和限制

blocks.en: The following limitations supplement the core scope statement in the main text.
blocks.zh: 以下限制补充了正文中的核心范围说明.

blocks.en: The intended positive impact of UBE is more equitable multilingual access: by lowering token budgets for scripts that are structurally penalized under UTF-8 BBPE, the method can increase usable context and reduce truncation pressure, compute cost, and latency disparities for users whose languages rely on BMP 3-byte UTF-8 encodings and therefore remain close to the byte fallback floor. The main negative risk is that the same context-capacity gains can be folded into more capable multilingual LMs, including systems that may be deployed for surveillance, misinformation, or other harmful applications. We therefore frame UBE as a tokenizer-level context-capacity and allocative-fairness intervention rather than as a complete solution to broader social fairness or misuse risks.
blocks.zh: UBE的预期积极影响是更公平的多语言访问:通过降低在UTF-8 BBPE下受到结构性惩罚的脚本的符号预算,该方法可以增加可用上下文,并降低调值压力,计算成本,以及对于语言依赖BMP3字节UTF-8编码从而仍然接近字节倒数层的用户的延迟差异. 主要的负面风险是,同样的上下文容量的增加可以折叠成更有能力的多语种LMs,包括可能用于监视、误导或其他有害应用的系统。 因此,我们把UBE定义为一种象征性的环境能力和分配公平性干预,而不是对更广泛的社会公平或滥用风险的全面解决办法。

blocks.en: Our primary evaluation relies on translated parallel text (FLORES-200), which may exhibit translationese artifacts; we check consistency on three additional corpora (UDHR, SIB-200, MGSM), using corpus-level aggregation without sentence alignment. Token premiums are computed relative to English throughout, and both Gini and variance exclude the English reference row. For a fixed set of non-English languages, changing only the common normalization factor leaves Gini unchanged; it does not imply invariance to pairwise-ratio aggregation.
blocks.zh: 我们的初级评价依赖于翻译的平行文本(FLORES-200),这些文本可能展示翻译文物;我们检查另外三个公司(UDHR、SIB-200、MGSM)的一致性,使用没有句子对齐的体积汇总。 托肯保费是按整个英文计算的,吉尼和差异均不包括英文参考行。 对于一组固定的非英语语言,只改变共同的正常化因子使得吉尼不变;这并不意味着对等-ratio聚合的偏差.

blocks.en: UBE’s dual alphabet reserves 256 extra initial symbols relative to BBPE, so at very narrow tokenizer-training coverage and small vocabularies (the En-only/16K stress regime) UBE wins in only 37 of 204 languages; the main-text alphabet-separation trade-off discussion notes that the absolute per-language regressions are small (median 0.016 tokens per sentence at En-only/32K ) and that Gini still falls at En-only/16K (-13.9%), but users of very-narrow-coverage compact tokenizers should expect a reduced per-language win rate rather than a uniform improvement.
blocks.zh: UBE的双字母表相对BBPE保留了256个额外的初始符号,因此在非常狭义的标致器-训练覆盖范围和小词汇(En- only/16K压力制度)中,UBE只以204种语言中的37种获胜;主文本字母-分隔的权衡讨论指出,每个语言的绝对回归是很小的(En- only/32K每句的中间0.016个符号),而吉尼仍然只有En-l/16K(13.9%),但非常窄的标致器的使用者应该期望每个语言的胜率会降低而不是统一改善.

blocks.en: The largest intrinsic token-count reductions are on low-coverage 3-byte scripts such as Santali, Central Atlas Tamazight, and Tibetan. These languages are not included in the 101-language mC4 LM corpus used for downstream training and evaluation, so the downstream experiments test the tokenizer mechanism indirectly rather than measuring gains for those exact languages.
blocks.zh: 最大的内在符号计数减少发生在低覆盖的3字节脚本上,如Santali,Central Atlas Tamazight,和藏文. 这些语言不包含在用于下游培训和评价的101语言mC4LM体例中,因此下游实验间接测试了标致器机制,而不是为这些精确语言测量收益.

blocks.en: Because the SuperBPE composition changes both encoding substrate and pre-tokenization, we interpret the interaction analysis narrowly. In the 2 × 2 2\times 2 factorial design, the interaction term is bounded but sign-changing (-1.1% on average across 16K–256K; per-vocabulary values in Appendix D.3 ), supporting qualitative complementarity rather than uniform additivity in the setting we test. Our SuperBPE re-implementation follows the reference recipe [ Liu et al., 2025 ] : the same permissive regex, the four-word cap on merged tokens (Appendix A.1.2 of that paper), and the colon-space block (Appendix A.1.4).
blocks.zh: 因为SuperBPE的成分既会改变编码底物,也会改变预token化,所以我们对交互分析的解释很狭隘. 在2×2 2\times 2因子设计中,交互术语是限定但改变符号的(平均在16K-256K之间为-1.1%);在附录D.3中为每伏值),支持定性互补,而不是在我们测试的设定中统一相加。 我们的SuperBPE重新执行遵循了参考食谱[Liu等人,2025年]:相同的允许性regex,合并令牌上的四字盖(该文件的附录A.1.2),以及结肠-空格块(附录A.1.4).

blocks.en: UBE’s dual-alphabet design forgoes a form of coincidental sharing available to BBPE’s single UTF-8 byte alphabet: BBPE can sometimes learn merges that reuse shared byte values across scripts or around universal characters such as whitespace and punctuation. This occasionally helps high-coverage languages like Georgian and Amharic, whereas UBE keeps UTF-8-path and UTF-16-path bytes distinct to preserve marker-free decoding (see the main-text alphabet-separation trade-off discussion ); future work could explore selective sharing for a small set of universal characters to mitigate these regressions while preserving the disjoint-alphabet decoding guarantee.
blocks.zh: UBE的双甲苯设计放弃了BBPE单一UTF-8字节字母可用的一种巧合分享形式: BBPE有时可以学习在脚本之间或围绕诸如白空和圆点等通用字符重复使用共享字节值的合并. 这偶尔会帮助格鲁吉亚语和阿姆哈拉语等高覆盖语言,而UBE则保留UTF-8-path和UTF-16-path字节区分,以保持无标记解码(见主文本字母-分隔交换讨论);未来的工作可以探索有选择地共享一小组通用字符,以缓解这些回归,同时保留脱联的αbet解码保证.

blocks.en: The core intrinsic matrix uses the GPT-2 regex pre-tokenizer; results under other boundary policies may differ. The SuperBPE- and SCRIPT-style matched comparisons in Appendix E show that replacing BBPE with UBE still reduces the reported sequence-length quantities under two substantially different pre-tokenization policies, but this does not establish invariance to all possible boundary rules.
blocks.zh: 核心内在矩阵使用GPT-2 regex预tokenizer;其他边界政策下的结果可能有所不同. SuperBPE和SCRIPT风格在附录E中的匹配比较表明,用UBE取代BBPE仍然会减少在两个大相径庭的切换前政策下报告的序列长数量,但这并不确定对所有可能的边界规则的偏差.

blocks.en: UBE routes characters independently; it is not a grapheme-aware tokenizer and does not normalize canonically equivalent strings beyond the configured upstream pre-tokenizer/normalizer. Scripts whose written units span multiple characters, zero-width joiner (ZWJ) sequences, and combining-mark sequences may therefore still require multiple routed units even when each character follows the intended encoding path.
blocks.zh: UBE 路由字符独立;它不是一个有图形意识的标致器,在配置的上游预tokenizer/正态器之外,没有正常的等效字符串. 其书面单位跨越多个字符的脚本,0width joiner(ZWJ)序列,以及组合-mark序列,因此即使在每个字符遵循预定的编码路径时,仍然可能需要多个路由单元.

blocks.en: The downstream LM experiments focus on isolating the byte-substrate change within otherwise matched training and evaluation pipelines. Appendix E includes tokenizer-level SCRIPT-BPE comparisons, a representation-only MYTE composition, a source-byte-matched LM comparison including BBPE16, and a separate matched-exposure model-level comparison with SCRIPT-BPE and a derived 32K MYTE+BPE variant. The latter changes several tokenizer design axes jointly and uses one matched seed, so we interpret it as a comparison across tokenizer designs rather than causal isolation of the representation. Direct model-level comparisons with the released 256-symbol MYTE itself [ Limisiewicz et al., 2024 ] and Bit-level BPE [ Moon et al., 2025 ] remain future work.
blocks.zh: 下游LM实验的重点是将字节基质变化隔离在原本匹配的培训和评价管道内。 附 录 E包括标定剂级的SCRIPT-BPE比较,唯一表示的MYTE组成,包括BBPE16在内的源字节匹配的LM比较,以及与SCRIPT-BPE和衍生的32K MYTE+BPE的单独匹配曝光模型级比较. 后者联合修改了几个标致设计轴,并使用一个匹配的种子,所以我们把它解释为对标致设计的一种比较,而不是对表示的因果隔离. 与释放出来的256-符号MYTE本身[Limisiewicz等人,2024年]和Bit-level BPE[Moon等人,2025年]的直接模型级比较仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en: Because 4-byte UTF-8 code points remain 4 bytes under UTF-16 surrogate pairs, UBE provides no encoding-floor reduction for supplementary-plane characters. We have not evaluated UBE on symbol-heavy social-media or chat domains, so we do not claim robustness for those settings.
blocks.zh: 由于4字节的UTF-8代码点在UTF-16代对下仍为4字节,因此UBE没有为辅助飞机字符提供编码底片的减码. 我们没有评价UBE在符号重的社交媒体或聊天领域,

blocks.en: The dual-buffer decoder’s streaming and constrained-decoding requirements are detailed in Appendix A.4 ; our implementation supports both modes, but we have not benchmarked constrained-decoding throughput.
blocks.zh: 附录A.4详细列出了双重缓冲解码器的流码和受限解码要求;我们的实施支持两种模式,但我们没有衡量受限解码的吞吐量。

blocks.en: The two-phase distributed BPE pipeline applies the same shard-local singleton filtering before global merge selection for both BBPE and UBE. Because filtering operates at the word level—and both tokenizers share the same Stage 1 regex split, word boundaries, and per-word frequencies on the same text—it removes the same raw word types in both conditions; only the byte-level representation of retained words differs. The filtering step therefore does not act as a confound between BBPE and UBE.
blocks.zh: 两相分布的BPE管道在对BBPE和UBE进行全球合并选择之前,采用了相同的硬-局部单吨滤波法. 因为过滤在单词级别上运行——两个标语符都共享相同的阶段1 regex分词,单词边界,以及同一文本上的每字频率——它在两个条件中都会去掉相同的原始词类型;只有保留词的字节级别表示不同. 因此,过滤步骤并不是BBPE和UBE之间的混淆。
